By bridging the gap between the task-specific precision of student models and the segmentation priors of generalist foundation models, we propose \textbf{MuDuo}, a mutual distillation framework that synergistically leverages SAM-Med3D for CT and SegAnyPET for PET to distill their knowledge into a lightweight student network. Our approach eliminates the need for manual prompts while maximizing the utility of unlabeled data for automatic segmentation, achieving state-of-the-art performance on the AutoPET dataset with only 5 labeled cases. Our source code is available at https://github.com/Wu-beining/MuDuo.

AI.tldr: 提出了MuDuo，一种利用视觉基础模型（SAM-Med3D和SegAnyPET）进行知识蒸馏的互蒸馏框架，仅需5个标注样本即可在PET/CT半监督分割任务上达到最优性能。
AI.motivation: PET/CT器官分割对肿瘤定量分析和放疗规划至关重要，但数据标注成本高昂。半监督学习虽有帮助，但现有方法未充分利用结构CT和代谢PET两种模态中基础模型的通用分割先验知识。
AI.method: 提出MuDuo互蒸馏框架，利用SAM-Med3D（CT模态）和SegAnyPET（PET模态）两种模态特异性基础模型作为教师，将知识蒸馏至轻量级学生网络；通过互蒸馏机制桥接基础模型的通用分割先验与学生模型的任务特定精度，无需人工提示即可自动分割。
AI.result: 在AutoPET数据集上仅用5个标注案例即达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 提出的MuDuo框架有效融合了不同模态基础模型的先验知识，显著降低了PET/CT分割对标注数据的需求，为半监督医学图像分割提供了高效解决方案。
AI.abstract_zh: PET/CT器官分割对于肿瘤学中的定量分析和放疗规划至关重要。为了降低PET/CT分割的高昂标注成本，半监督学习为在有限标注数据下开发深度模型提供了一种实用且有效的解决方案。视觉基础模型的最新发展展现出显著的适应性和更高的效率。在本工作中，我们提出了一种互蒸馏框架，该框架巧妙地利用了结构性和功能性基础模型，它们作为模态特异性的通才，从结构CT和代谢PET成像中蒸馏知识。通过弥合学生模型的任务特异性精度与通才基础模型的分割先验之间的差距，我们提出了MuDuo——一个互蒸馏框架，协同利用SAM-Med3D（用于CT）和SegAnyPET（用于PET），将它们的知识蒸馏至轻量级学生网络。我们的方法无需人工提示，同时最大化利用未标注数据进行自动分割，在仅使用5个标注案例的情况下，即在AutoPET数据集上达到了最先进的性能。我们的源代码已在https://github.com/Wu-beining/MuDuo公开。

title: Phys-JEPA: Physics-Informed Latent World Models for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
comment: Submitted to arXiv as a preliminary manuscript. 10 figures
summary: Multivariate forecasting in physical systems requires models that predict coupled temporal variables while preserving meaningful state evolution. Deep forecasters can fit temporal correlations, and physics-informed models can regularize predictions with scientific constraints, but these directions are often connected only at the decoded-output level. As a result, the hidden predictive state that generates future trajectories may remain statistically useful but physically unstructured. We introduce Phys-JEPA, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting. Phys-JEPA learns a latent world model in which predictive states are decomposed into physical and residual components, and physical consistency is imposed directly on latent states and latent transitions rather than only on decoded forecasts. This formulation uses known physical variables to organize the representation space while retaining residual capacity for unresolved dynamics. On Jena Climate 2009--2016, Phys-JEPA reduces aggregate MSE from 0.12482 to 0.12273 and temperature MSE from 0.01892 to 0.01831 at H=24. On Traffic, full Phys-JEPA improves aggregate MSE over the supervised baseline across all tested horizons, reducing H=192 MSE from 0.800784 to 0.773873. On Electricity, the best variant depends on horizon: static latent consistency is strongest at H=24 and H=48, while full Phys-JEPA gives the best aggregate and target-variable MSE at H=192. These initial results suggest that moving physics-informed learning from output space to latent predictive state space is a promising direction for interpretable temporal world models.

AI.tldr: Phys-JEPA是一种物理信息驱动的联合嵌入预测架构，用于多变量时间序列预测。它通过在潜在状态空间中施加物理一致性约束，而非仅在解码输出层面，学习一个分解为物理分量和残差分量的潜在世界模型。在Jena Climate、Traffic和Electricity三个数据集上的实验表明，该方法在预测精度上优于监督基线，证明了将物理约束从输出空间迁移到潜在预测状态空间是一种有前景的路径。
AI.motivation: 现有深度预测器能拟合时间相关性，物理信息模型能在解码输出层施加科学约束，但这两者的结合往往仅在输出层面，导致隐藏预测状态虽然统计上有用但缺乏物理结构。作者希望将物理一致性约束直接施加在潜在状态和潜在状态转换上，使预测状态既保持统计效用又具备物理意义。
AI.method: Phys-JEPA是一种物理信息驱动的联合嵌入预测架构。它将潜在预测状态分解为物理分量和残差分量，直接在潜在状态和潜在状态转换上施加物理一致性约束，而非仅在解码预测上。利用已知物理变量组织表示空间，同时保留对未解析动力学的残差容量。
AI.result: 在Jena Climate 2009-2016上，H=24时聚合MSE从0.12482降至0.12273，温度MSE从0.01892降至0.01831。在Traffic上，完整Phys-JEPA在所有预测范围内均优于监督基线，H=192时MSE从0.800784降至0.773873。在Electricity上，最优变体取决于预测范围：静态潜在一致性在H=24和H=48最强，完整Phys-JEPA在H=192时给出最佳聚合和目标变量MSE。
AI.conclusion: 将物理信息学习从输出空间迁移到潜在预测状态空间是构建可解释时间世界模型的一个有前景的方向。
AI.abstract_zh: 物理系统中的多变量预测要求模型在预测耦合时间变量的同时保持有意义的状态演化。深度预测器可以拟合时间相关性，物理信息模型可以用科学约束正则化预测，但这些方向通常仅在解码输出层面相连。因此，生成未来轨迹的隐藏预测状态可能在统计上有用，但在物理上是无结构的。我们提出了Phys-JEPA，一种面向多变量时间序列预测的物理信息联合嵌入预测架构。Phys-JEPA学习一个潜在世界模型，其中预测状态被分解为物理分量和残差分量，物理一致性直接施加在潜在状态和潜在状态转换上，而非仅施加在解码预测上。该公式利用已知物理变量组织表示空间，同时保留对未解析动力学的残差容量。在Jena Climate 2009-2016上，Phys-JEPA在H=24时将聚合MSE从0.12482降至0.12273，温度MSE从0.01892降至0.01831。在Traffic上，完整Phys-JEPA在所有测试预测范围内均优于监督基线，将H=192的MSE从0.800784降至0.773873。在Electricity上，最优变体取决于预测范围：静态潜在一致性在H=24和H=48时最强，而完整Phys-JEPA在H=192时给出最佳聚合和目标变量MSE。这些初步结果表明，将物理信息学习从输出空间迁移到潜在预测状态空间是构建可解释时间世界模型的一个有前景的方向。

title: Variational Test-time Optimization for Diffusion Synchronization
summary: Collaborative generation, which coordinates multiple diffusion trajectories to extend the capabilities of pretrained priors, has emerged as a powerful paradigm for extending the applicability of diffusion models. Among existing approaches, diffusion synchronization provides a scenario-agnostic solution by introducing general guidance mechanisms. However, current synchronization approaches rely heavily on heuristics and still require task-specific tailoring, which limits their generalizability and performance. In this work, we mathematically derive a synchronization framework based on optimal control, providing a principled explanation of diffusion synchronization. During sampling, we optimize control variables to guide multiple trajectories toward coherent solutions while remaining close to the underlying diffusion prior. Our method operates entirely at test-time without additional training, thereby enabling broad applicability across diverse generation scenarios when combined with strong pretrained priors. We demonstrate consistent improvements over baselines on three representative collaborative generation tasks, covering a wide range of modalities and applications. Beyond performance gains, our work establishes a novel foundation for collaborative generation, opening a principled path toward extending pretrained generative models to new collaborative generation settings.

AI.tldr: 本文基于最优控制理论数学推导了一个扩散同步框架，无需训练即可在测试时引导多条扩散轨迹协同生成，在多种模态的协作生成任务上优于基线方法，为协作生成建立了原理性基础。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散同步方法依赖启发式规则且需要针对特定任务进行调整，缺乏通用性和理论支撑，限制了其表现和泛化能力。
AI.method: 基于最优控制理论数学推导扩散同步框架，在采样过程中优化控制变量，引导多条扩散轨迹朝向一致解，同时保持与底层扩散先验的接近；完全在测试时运行，无需额外训练。
AI.result: 在三个代表性协作生成任务（覆盖多种模态和应用）上，该方法一致性地优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为协作生成建立了新的理论基础，开辟了一条将预训练生成模型扩展到新型协作生成场景的原理性路径。
AI.abstract_zh: 协作生成通过协调多条扩散轨迹来扩展预训练先验的能力，已成为扩展扩散模型适用性的强大范式。在现有方法中，扩散同步通过引入通用引导机制提供了一种场景无关的解决方案。然而，当前的同步方法严重依赖启发式规则，仍需针对特定任务进行调整，这限制了其泛化能力和性能。在本工作中，我们基于最优控制理论数学推导了一个同步框架，为扩散同步提供了原理性解释。在采样过程中，我们优化控制变量以引导多条轨迹朝向一致解，同时保持与底层扩散先验的接近。我们的方法完全在测试时运行，无需额外训练，因此当与强预训练先验结合时，能够在多种生成场景中广泛应用。我们在三个代表性协作生成任务上展示了一致优于基线的结果，这些任务覆盖了广泛的模态和应用。除了性能提升，我们的工作为协作生成建立了新的基础，开辟了一条将预训练生成模型扩展到新型协作生成设置的原理性路径。

title: Auditing Machine Unlearning: A Systematic Research on Whether Models Truly Forget
summary: Machine unlearning has been extensively studied in response to growing privacy concerns and regulatory requirements. However, auditing whether unlearning algorithms have truly erased the influence of specific data remains an open challenge. The lack of reliable and practical auditing mechanisms can lead to critical privacy risks, such as residual information leakage. This paper initiates a systematic investigation into whether existing unlearning algorithms can truly forget the designated data. We propose the first practical and general-purpose auditing framework for machine unlearning, inspired by the concept of proof of ignorance. Our framework addresses the key practicality limitations of existing methods by eliminating the need for retraining-from-scratch baselines, avoiding the training of large numbers of shadow models, and requiring no intrusive intervention in the original training process. To evaluate the effectiveness of our framework, we first conduct validation experiments to verify its soundness and completeness. We then perform comprehensive experiments across six datasets and ten representative unlearning methods. The results demonstrate that our framework reliably distinguishes between successful and failed unlearning. In particular, we observe that retraining-based and fine-tuning-based methods can achieve effective unlearning, even when the target data remain in the original dataset. In contrast, de-optimization-based methods fail to achieve true unlearning and instead degrade the model's performance. Fisher/Hessian-based methods also fail to unlearn requested data, even formal certification is provided. Moreover, we show that our framework is robust against fake unlearning attempts and generalizes well to large language models.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地研究了现有机器遗忘算法是否真正实现了数据遗忘，提出了首个实用且通用的遗忘审计框架（基于“无知证明”概念），并通过大量实验揭示了不同类型遗忘方法的真实效果：基于重训练和微调的方法有效，而基于去优化和Fisher/Hessian的方法未能真正遗忘。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘算法缺乏可靠且实用的审计机制来验证是否真正擦除了特定数据的影响，导致残留信息泄露等隐私风险。现有审计方法需要从头重训练基线、训练大量影子模型或对原始训练过程进行侵入式干预，实用性差。
AI.method: 提出基于“无知证明”（proof of ignorance）概念的实用通用机器遗忘审计框架，无需从头重训练基线、避免训练大量影子模型、无需侵入式干预原始训练过程。
AI.result: 在6个数据集和10种代表性遗忘方法上验证了框架的有效性。重训练和微调方法能实现有效遗忘（即使目标数据仍保留在原始数据集中）；去优化方法无法实现真正遗忘且会降低模型性能；Fisher/Hessian方法即使提供形式化认证也无法真正遗忘。框架对虚假遗忘尝试具有鲁棒性，并能有效泛化到大型语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的遗忘审计框架可靠地区分了成功与失败的遗忘，揭示了不同遗忘方法的真实效果差异。研究强调了实用审计机制对确保机器遗忘可信性的重要性。
AI.abstract_zh: 机器遗忘（machine unlearning）因日益增长的隐私关切和监管要求而被广泛研究。然而，审计遗忘算法是否真正擦除了特定数据的影响仍然是一个开放的挑战。缺乏可靠且实用的审计机制可能导致严重的隐私风险，例如残留信息泄露。本文首次系统性地探究现有遗忘算法是否能够真正遗忘指定数据。受"无知证明"（proof of ignorance）概念的启发，我们提出了首个实用且通用的机器遗忘审计框架。该框架消除了对从头重训练基线的需求，避免训练大量影子模型，且无需对原始训练过程进行侵入式干预，从而解决了现有方法的关键实用性限制。为评估框架的有效性，我们首先进行验证实验，检验其合理性与完备性。随后在六个数据集和十种代表性遗忘方法上开展全面实验。结果表明，我们的框架能够可靠地区分成功遗忘与失败遗忘。值得注意的是，我们发现基于重训练（retraining-based）和基于微调（fine-tuning-based）的方法能够实现有效遗忘，即使目标数据仍保留在原始数据集中。相比之下，基于去优化（de-optimization-based）的方法未能实现真正遗忘，反而降低了模型性能。基于Fisher/Hessian的方法即使提供了形式化认证，也无法真正遗忘请求数据。此外，实验表明我们的框架对虚假遗忘尝试具有鲁棒性，并能很好地泛化到大型语言模型。

title: NeRD: Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation for Efficient Ontology-Grounded Chain-of-Thought in Medical Image Diagnosis
summary: Interpretability is essential for trustworthy medical image diagnosis. However, existing concept-driven interpretable methods have key limitations: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) require scoring all predefined concepts at inference time and for manual intervention, imposing a substantial burden on clinicians, while rationale-based generative approaches often select concepts by class discriminability, which can drift from diagnostic ontologies. To address these issues, we propose Neuro-Symbolic Rule Distillation (NeRD), a framework that produces efficient, ontology-grounded reasoning chains that are sufficient yet non-redundant, without manually crafting diagnostic rules. Experiments on two skin datasets demonstrate strong diagnostic performance and interpretability, and blinded expert evaluation confirms the clinical plausibility of NeRD rationales. Our method further enables a first expert-in-the-loop study for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought-based diagnosis, achieving efficient and effective concept-level intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出神经符号规则蒸馏（NeRD）框架，通过本体对齐的因果推理链实现高效、非冗余且临床可解释的医学图像诊断，避免了人工设计诊断规则和高负担的概念评分。
AI.motivation: 现有概念驱动可解释方法存在关键局限：概念瓶颈模型（CBM）需在推理时对所有预定义概念评分并依赖人工干预，临床负担重；基于理据的生成方法常按类别可区分性选择概念，偏离诊断本体论。
AI.method: 提出神经符号规则蒸馏（NeRD）框架，生成基于本体对齐的高效推理链，确保充分性且无冗余，无需手工构建诊断规则。
AI.result: 在两个皮肤数据集上表现出强诊断性能和可解释性；盲法专家评估证实NeRD理据的临床合理性；首次实现专家在环的多模态思维链诊断，实现高效且有效的概念级干预。
AI.conclusion: NeRD能生成与临床本体一致的高效、非冗余推理链，兼具强诊断性能和临床可解释性，并支持专家在环的交互式诊断。
AI.abstract_zh: 可解释性对于值得信赖的医学图像诊断至关重要。然而，现有的概念驱动可解释方法存在关键局限性：概念瓶颈模型（CBM）需要在推理时对所有预定义概念进行评分并依赖人工干预，给临床医生带来沉重负担；而基于理据的生成方法通常按类别可区分性选择概念，这可能会偏离诊断本体论。为解决这些问题，我们提出了神经符号规则蒸馏（NeRD）框架，该框架能生成高效、基于本体的推理链，这些链充分且无冗余，无需手动构建诊断规则。在两个皮肤数据集上的实验表明，该方法具有强大的诊断性能和可解释性，盲法专家评估证实了NeRD理据的临床合理性。我们的方法还首次实现了基于多模态思维链诊断的专家在环研究，实现了高效且有效的概念级干预。

title: Scaling Adaptive Depth with Norm-Agnostic Residual Networks
summary: Residual architectures are ubiquitous in deep learning, but they suffer from a subtle structural limitation: the norm of the residual stream can grow rapidly with depth. As a result, updates from later layers become small relative to the accumulated residual state. This reduces their impact on the representation and limits the benefits of scaling models in depth. To address this, we introduce NAG, a norm-agnostic residual architecture that separates magnitude from directional information in the residual stream, preserving meaningful layer contributions throughout depth and preventing later updates from being systematically suppressed by residual-norm growth. Importantly, NAG introduces only a negligible number of additional parameters and relies on simple operations that are easily kernel-fusible, preserving training efficiency in practice. We show that this architecture outperforms baseline Transformers, with gains that increase substantially as depth grows, enabling effective training of much deeper models. The norm-agnostic formulation also leads to an interpretable Mixture-of-Depths (MoD) mechanism that adaptively skips both attention and MLP layers. Beyond serving as a post-training accuracy-compute tradeoff, this mechanism can be used as a pretraining-time scaling strategy: under iso-FLOP training, compute saved by reducing per-token forward-pass cost can be reinvested into training on more tokens while keeping the total parameter count and KV-cache budget fixed. In our experiments, moderate Mixture-of-Depths rates of approximately 20%-25% match full-depth baseline performance under equal training compute while substantially reducing the number of executed layer parameters and forward-pass FLOPs. These results identify sparsity in depth as a new scaling axis for fixed-compute training, enabling very deep yet FLOP-efficient models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NAG（范数无关残差架构），通过将残差流中的幅度与方向信息分离，解决了深层网络中残差范数增长导致后续层贡献被抑制的问题。该架构仅引入极少额外参数，支持更深模型的有效训练，并自然衍生出可解释的深度混合（MoD）机制，在固定算力下通过跳过部分层实现训练效率提升，将深度稀疏性作为一种新的扩展维度。
AI.motivation: 现有残差架构存在一个结构性缺陷：残差流的范数随深度快速增大，导致深层网络中的后续层更新相对于累积的残差状态变得很小，削弱了它们对表征的贡献，限制了深度扩展带来的收益。
AI.method: 提出NAG（Norm-Agnostic残差架构），将残差流中的幅度信息与方向信息分离，确保各层在深度方向上都能做出有意义的贡献，防止后续更新被残差范数增长系统性抑制。该架构仅引入极少量额外参数，使用易于内核融合的简单操作。同时，NAG自然衍生出可解释的深度混合（Mixture-of-Depths, MoD）机制，能自适应地跳过注意力和MLP层。
AI.result: NAG架构在深度增加时性能增益显著提升，支持训练更深的模型。在等FLOP训练下，约20%-25%的MoD率即可匹配全深度基线性能，同时大幅减少执行层参数和前向FLOPs。深度稀疏性可作为固定算力训练下的新扩展维度。
AI.conclusion: NAG通过分离幅度与方向信息有效解决了残差范数增长问题，使训练极深模型成为可能。其衍生的MoD机制不仅可作为训练后精度-计算权衡工具，还可作为预训练时的扩展策略，将深度稀疏性确立为固定算力训练的新扩展轴。
AI.abstract_zh: 残差架构在深度学习中无处不在，但它们存在一个微妙的架构局限性：残差流的范数会随深度快速增大。因此，深层网络中的后续层更新相对于累积的残差状态而言变得很小。这降低了它们对表征的影响，并限制了模型在深度方向扩展的收益。为解决此问题，我们提出了NAG，一种范数无关的残差架构，它将残差流中的幅度信息与方向信息分离，在深度方向上保留有意义的层贡献，并防止后续更新被残差范数增长系统性抑制。重要的是，NAG仅引入可忽略不计的额外参数，且依赖易于内核融合的简单操作，从而在实践中保持训练效率。我们证明该架构优于基线Transformer模型，且随着深度增加其增益显著提升，能够支持有效训练更深的模型。这种范数无关的公式还衍生出一种可解释的深度混合（Mixture-of-Depths, MoD）机制，该机制可自适应地跳过注意力和MLP层。除了作为训练后的精度-计算量权衡工具外，该机制还可作为预训练阶段的扩展策略：在等FLOP训练条件下，通过降低每token前向传播成本节省的计算量可以重新投入到训练更多token上，同时保持总参数量和KV缓存预算不变。在我们的实验中，中等程度的深度混合率（约20%-25%）在相等训练计算量下即可匹配全深度基线的性能，同时大幅减少执行的层参数量和前向FLOPs。这些结果将深度稀疏性确立为固定算力训练下的一个新扩展轴，使得训练极深但FLOP高效的模型成为可能。

title: XPASS-Vis: A Dataset for Cross-Domain Personalized Image Aesthetic Assessment
summary: Personalized image aesthetic assessment (PIAA) seeks to model, at the individual level, the subjective nature of aesthetic judgments toward artworks and photographs. Aesthetic preference is known to be both deeply personal and partially consistent across visual domains. Yet existing PIAA datasets and methods are largely confined to a single domain, or provide too few samples per annotator within each domain to enable personalization across domains. Consequently, the cross-domain generalization of personalized aesthetic preferences remains largely unexplored. To address this gap, we introduce XPASS-Vis, the first dataset explicitly designed for cross-domain PIAA. XPASS-Vis comprises 6,526 stimuli from three visual domains -- art, fashion, and landscape -- rated by 129 annotators, yielding 87,836 user-stimulus interactions, each annotated with an overall aesthetic score and nine aesthetic-emotion ratings. Notably, each annotator rated more than 200 stimuli per domain, providing sufficient per-domain coverage to support personalization both within and across domains. Moreover, we establish baseline models for cross-domain PIAA under unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA), where a model trained on a labeled source domain is transferred to an unlabeled target domain. A systematic evaluation of representative UDA approaches shows that the best-performing method recovers approximately 60\% (Spearman's $ρ$ = .28) of the supervised upper bound under a fully unsupervised setting. This provides encouraging evidence that personalized aesthetic preferences are, to a meaningful extent, transferable across visual domains. At the same time, a substantial gap remains, highlighting the need for PIAA-specific adaptation strategies. XPASS-Vis and the accompanying baselines provide a foundation for future research on cross-domain PIAA. All datasets and code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个专为跨域个性化图像美学评估（PIAA）设计的数据集XPASS-Vis，包含三大视觉领域（艺术、时尚、风景）共6,526个刺激样本和87,836条用户-刺激交互记录，并建立了无监督域适应（UDA）基线模型，实验表明个性化审美偏好在跨域条件下具有一定可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有PIAA数据集和方法大多局限于单一领域，或每个域内每位标注者的样本量过少，无法支持跨域个性化建模，导致个性化审美偏好的跨域泛化能力尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 构建了XPASS-Vis数据集（3个域，6,526个刺激，129位标注者，87,836条交互），并采用无监督域适应（UDA）框架建立基线模型：在标注源域上训练，迁移到未标注目标域，系统评估多种代表性UDA方法。
AI.result: 最佳UDA方法在完全无监督设定下恢复了约60%的有监督上限性能（Spearman ρ = .28），表明个性化审美偏好可在视觉域间实现有意义程度的迁移，但仍存在较大差距。
AI.conclusion: 个性化审美偏好在跨视觉域条件下具有可迁移性，但现有UDA方法尚不充分，亟需开发针对PIAA的专用域适应策略；XPASS-Vis为后续跨域PIAA研究提供了基础。
AI.abstract_zh: 个性化图像美学评估（PIAA）旨在个体层面上对艺术作品和照片的主观审美判断进行建模。众所周知，审美偏好既具有深刻的个人独特性，又在不同视觉领域间存在一定一致性。然而，现有的PIAA数据集和方法大多局限于单一领域，或每个域内每位标注者的样本量过少，无法实现跨域个性化。因此，个性化审美偏好的跨域泛化能力在很大程度上仍未被探索。为解决这一空白，我们提出了XPASS-Vis，这是首个专为跨域PIAA设计的数据集。XPASS-Vis包含来自三个视觉域——艺术、时尚和风景——的6,526个刺激样本，由129位标注者评分，共产生87,836条用户-刺激交互记录，每条记录包含一个整体美学评分和九个美学情感评分。值得注意的是，每位标注者在每个域内均评分了超过200个刺激样本，提供了充分的域内覆盖以支持域内和跨域个性化。此外，我们在无监督域适应（UDA）框架下建立了跨域PIAA的基线模型，即在标注源域上训练的模型迁移到未标注目标域。对代表性UDA方法的系统评估表明，最佳方法在完全无监督设定下恢复了约60%（Spearman ρ = .28）的有监督上限性能。这提供了令人鼓舞的证据，表明个性化审美偏好在很大程度上可在不同视觉域间迁移。同时，性能差距仍然显著，凸显了开发PIAA专用域适应策略的必要性。XPASS-Vis及配套基线为未来跨域PIAA研究奠定了基础。所有数据集和代码在接收后将公开发布。

title: A Gradient Perspective on RLVR Stability and Winner Advantage Policy Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves language-model reasoning, but GRPO-style optimization remains prone to collapse. We analyse this instability through token-level gradient dynamics, deriving a taxonomy that predicts how updates affect next-token probabilities and entropy. The taxonomy shows that stability depends jointly on the advantage sign and token distribution under the current policy. Motivated by this finding, we propose Winner Advantage Policy Optimization (WAPO), a simple online clipped policy-gradient objective that updates only on positive-advantage completions. Across mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, WAPO improves training stability and matches or outperforms baselines across multiple model families. Full code can be found at https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/wapo.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了GRPO风格优化在RLVR中容易崩溃的问题，通过token级梯度动力学推导出稳定性分类法，并提出WAPO方法——仅在正优势完成轨迹上进行策略梯度更新，在数学推理和多跳QA基准上提升了训练稳定性并达到或超越基线。
AI.motivation: GRPO风格的优化在强化学习与可验证奖励结合时容易发生训练崩溃（collapse），现有方法缺乏对这种不稳定性的深入分析。
AI.method: 通过token级梯度动力学分析，推导出一个分类法（taxonomy）来预测更新对下一token概率和熵的影响；基于此发现提出WAPO（Winner Advantage Policy Optimization），一种简单的在线裁剪策略梯度目标函数，仅在正优势的完成轨迹上执行更新。
AI.result: 在数学推理和多跳QA基准上，WAPO提升了训练稳定性，并在多个模型族上匹配或超越基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 证明了稳定性取决于优势符号和当前策略下的token分布，WAPO作为一种简单有效的改进方案，能够在不增加复杂性的前提下提升RLVR训练的稳定性。
AI.abstract_zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）提升了语言模型的推理能力，但GRPO风格的优化仍然容易崩溃。我们通过token级梯度动力学分析了这种不稳定性，推导出一个分类法，用于预测更新如何影响下一token概率和熵。该分类法表明，稳定性共同取决于优势符号和当前策略下的token分布。受此发现启发，我们提出了Winner Advantage Policy Optimization（WAPO），一种简单的在线裁剪策略梯度目标函数，仅在正优势的完成轨迹上执行更新。在数学推理和多跳问答基准上，WAPO提升了训练稳定性，并在多个模型族上匹配或超越基线方法。完整代码可访问 https://github.com/layer6ai-labs/wapo。

title: Open-World Video Segmentation
summary: While video segmentation has advanced rapidly on short clips and closed-set benchmarks, open-world video segmentation remains largely unexplored. The challenge is twofold: (1) existing methods are not designed to support object discovery and identity maintenance in long videos of dynamic ego-motion, and (2) existing evaluation protocols rely on a rigid 1:1 matching that unfairly penalizes semantically valid predictions with mismatched granularity. To address both gaps, we introduce Savvy, a practical and strong system for zero-shot open-world long-horizon video segmentation. Savvy combines hierarchical mask discovery, deferred admission, and track consolidation to support persistent object discovery, safe track promotion, and stable long-range identity maintenance. We further propose OGA, a granularity-aware evaluation suite for open-world video segmentation. Built on a Granularity-Agnostic (GA) matching protocol, OGA relaxes conventional 1:1 matching to an n:1 mapping, but still enforces temporal rigor by detecting support discontinuities through sever points and scoring each reference object through its dominant coherent fragment. This prevents fragmented or flickering support from being over-rewarded while enabling GA-adapted metrics and structural diagnostics: identity persistence (IP), and identity concentration (IC). On VIPSeg, we show that standard 1:1 evaluation substantially underestimates open-world methods, whereas GA evaluation recovers much of their suppressed performance. On the more realistic long-horizon benchmarks: ScanNet and HM3D, Savvy consistently outperforms strong baselines across both classical and proposed metrics, including STQ, VPQ$_\infty$, IP and IC. Together, these results establish a practical benchmark and a strong baseline for open-world long-horizon video segmentation.

AI.tldr: Savvy提出了一种零样本开放世界长时视频分割系统，结合分层掩码发现、延迟准入和轨迹合并技术，并配套提出了粒度感知评估套件OGA（基于n:1匹配协议），在VIPSeg、ScanNet和HM3D上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频分割方法在短片段和闭集基准上表现良好，但无法支持开放世界长视频中的目标发现和身份维持；同时现有评估协议采用严格的1:1匹配，不公平地惩罚了粒度不匹配但语义有效的预测。
AI.method: (1) Savvy系统：融合分层掩码发现、延迟准入和轨迹合并，实现持久目标发现、安全轨迹提升和稳定长程身份维持。(2) OGA评估套件：提出粒度无关匹配协议，将1:1匹配放宽为n:1映射，通过断点检测支持不连续性，基于主导连贯片段对参考目标评分，并引入身份持久性和身份集中度等诊断指标。
AI.result: 在VIPSeg上，标准1:1评估严重低估开放世界方法，而GA评估恢复了大片被抑制的性能。在ScanNet和HM3D长时基准上，Savvy在STQ、VPQ∞、IP和IC等指标上持续优于强基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为开放世界长时视频分割建立了实用基准和强基线，证明了粒度感知评估的必要性以及Savvy系统在长时开放场景中的有效性。
AI.abstract_zh: 尽管视频分割在短片段和闭集基准上取得了快速进展，但开放世界视频分割仍未得到充分探索。挑战有两方面：(1) 现有方法不支持在动态自我运动的长视频中进行目标发现和身份维持；(2) 现有评估协议依赖严格的1:1匹配，不公平地惩罚了粒度不匹配但语义有效的预测。为弥补这两项空白，我们提出了Savvy，一个实用的零样本开放世界长时视频分割强系统。Savvy结合了分层掩码发现、延迟准入和轨迹合并，以支持持久目标发现、安全轨迹提升和稳定长程身份维持。我们进一步提出了OGA，一个面向开放世界视频分割的粒度感知评估套件。OGA基于粒度无关匹配协议，将传统1:1匹配放宽为n:1映射，同时通过断点检测支持不连续性，并基于每个参考目标的主导连贯片段对其进行评分，从而保持时间上的严谨性。这防止了碎片化或闪烁的支持被过度奖励，同时支持粒度无关适配的指标和结构性诊断：身份持久性和身份集中度。在VIPSeg上，我们表明标准1:1评估严重低估了开放世界方法，而GA评估恢复了大片被抑制的性能。在更真实的长时基准ScanNet和HM3D上，Savvy在经典指标和所提指标（包括STQ、VPQ∞、IP和IC）上均持续优于强基线。这些结果共同为开放世界长时视频分割建立了实用基准和强基线。

title: A comparative and critical study of EEGNet for fNIRS-driven cognitive load classification
summary: Accurately classifying cognitive load from functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) signals remains a significant challenge due to temporal variability, inter-subject differences, and sensitivity to preprocessing choices. This study provides a comprehensive evaluation of EEGNet for fNIRS-based cognitive load classification by systematically examining the effects of temporal segmentation strategies (overlapping vs. non-overlapping), window lengths (10s, 20s, 30s), feature extraction methods (Analysis of Variance (ANOVA), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Fast Independent Component Analysis (FastICA)), learning rate configurations (fixed and adaptive), and evaluation protocols (random split vs. subject-independent (SI)). Results from random-split experiments show that overlapping segmentation, combined with smaller fixed learning rates (0.01-0.001), yields the highest accuracies, due to temporal redundancy and dense sampling of hemodynamic transitions. However, SI evaluation reveals a substantial drop in accuracy, demonstrating limited generalization to unseen participants. Under SI evaluation, non-overlapping segmentation outperformed overlapping windows, with the best accuracy of 56.11% achieved using PCA features with a 20-second window and a 0.1 learning rate. These findings indicate that eliminating temporal redundancy helps the model learn more robust and generalizable representations of cognitive load across individuals. Although adaptive learning rate strategy improved training stability, it did not surpass the performance of optimally selected fixed learning rates. The study highlights the critical role of segmentation strategy and learning rate selection in improving model generalization and identifies methodological considerations essential for developing reliable, real-time, and SI cognitive load classification systems using fNIRS.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了EEGNet在fNIRS认知负荷分类中的表现，重点分析了时间分割策略、窗口长度、特征提取方法、学习率配置和评估协议对模型性能的影响。研究发现：随机分割下重叠窗口加小固定学习率效果最佳；但受试者独立评估下准确率骤降（最高56.11%），非重叠窗口表现更好。研究强调了分割策略和学习率选择对提升模型泛化能力的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 由于fNIRS信号存在时间变异性、受试者间差异以及对预处理选择的敏感性，准确分类认知负荷仍然是一个重大挑战。现有研究缺乏对EEGNet在fNIRS认知负荷分类任务中的系统评估，特别是对时间分割策略、特征提取方法和学习率配置等关键因素的全面比较。
AI.method: 采用EEGNet作为分类模型，系统比较了：(1) 时间分割策略（重叠vs非重叠窗口）；(2) 窗口长度（10秒、20秒、30秒）；(3) 特征提取方法（ANOVA、PCA、FastICA）；(4) 学习率配置（固定学习率vs自适应学习率）；(5) 评估协议（随机分割vs受试者独立评估）。
AI.result: (1) 随机分割实验中，重叠分割结合较小固定学习率（0.01-0.001）取得最高准确率；(2) 受试者独立评估下准确率大幅下降，非重叠分割表现优于重叠分割；(3) 受试者独立评估的最佳结果为PCA特征+20秒窗口+0.1学习率下56.11%准确率；(4) 自适应学习率策略提高了训练稳定性，但未超越最优固定学习率的性能。
AI.conclusion: 时间分割策略和学习率选择对提高模型泛化能力至关重要；消除时间冗余（非重叠分割）有助于模型学习更鲁棒、更可泛化的认知负荷表征；研究为开发可靠、实时的受试者独立fNIRS认知负荷分类系统提供了方法论指导。
AI.abstract_zh: 由于时间变异性、受试者间差异以及对预处理选择的敏感性，从功能性近红外光谱（fNIRS）信号中准确分类认知负荷仍然是一项重大挑战。本研究通过对时间分割策略（重叠与非重叠）、窗口长度（10秒、20秒、30秒）、特征提取方法（方差分析、主成分分析、快速独立成分分析）、学习率配置（固定与自适应）以及评估协议（随机分割与受试者独立）的系统性考察，对EEGNet在基于fNIRS的认知负荷分类中进行了全面评估。随机分割实验的结果表明，重叠分割结合较小的固定学习率（0.01-0.001）可获得最高准确率，这归因于时间冗余以及对血流动力学过渡阶段的密集采样。然而，受试者独立评估显示准确率大幅下降，表明模型对未见参与者的泛化能力有限。在受试者独立评估下，非重叠分割的表现优于重叠窗口，使用主成分分析特征、20秒窗口和0.1学习率取得了56.11%的最佳准确率。这些发现表明，消除时间冗余有助于模型学习跨个体更鲁棒、更可泛化的认知负荷表征。虽然自适应学习率策略提高了训练稳定性，但其性能并未超越经过优化选择的固定学习率。本研究凸显了分割策略和学习率选择在提升模型泛化能力中的关键作用，并指出了开发基于fNIRS的可靠、实时、受试者独立认知负荷分类系统所需考虑的方法论要素。

title: Fusing Transferred Priors and Physics-based Decomposition for Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: The underwater images are captured within diverse water-medium conditions, leading to complex degradation, including color bias, low contrast, and blur effect. Recently, learning-based methods have demonstrated their potential for underwater image enhancement (UIE). However, most of the previous work focus on the training strategy or network design to make the enhanced result aligned well with the labels in datasets, ignoring that the labels are selected from the enhanced results of previous UIE methods and these pseudo-labels are noisy. Consequently, the performance of their models is not satisfactory to a certain extent. However, collecting the true labels of the underwater images is challenging. In this work, we propose a transfer learning-based UIE that does not require underwater images to have paired noisy or true labels for learning. Instead, the UIE task is first divided into global color correction, haze removal, and background noise suppression following the underwater physics. Then multiple types of prior from other vision tasks are leveraged as cross-domain supervision in each step. In this way, a novel UIE is available via transfer learning, and the physics-aligned UIE decomposition provides theoretical soundness. Qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our proposal based on physics and priors fusion achieves SOTA performance in the UIE task and effectively boosts downstream vision tasks, significantly outperforming benchmark methods. Project repo: https://github.com/Haru2022/P2-UIE.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于迁移学习和物理先验融合的水下图像增强方法（P2-UIE），无需配对真值标签，通过将任务分解为全局颜色校正、去雾和背景噪声抑制三个子步骤，并利用跨视觉任务的多种先验知识进行监督，实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的水下图像增强方法过度依赖伪标签（由先前方法生成，存在噪声），而获取真实标签极其困难；因此需要一种无需配对噪声/真实标签即可学习的UIE方法。
AI.method: 首先依据水下物理特性将UIE任务分解为全局颜色校正、去雾和背景噪声抑制三个子步骤；然后在每个子步骤中利用来自其他视觉任务的多种先验知识作为跨域监督，通过迁移学习实现水下图像增强，无需配对标签。
AI.result: 定性和定量实验表明，所提出的基于物理与先验融合的方法在UIE任务上达到SOTA性能，并有效提升下游视觉任务，显著优于基准方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于物理分解和跨域先验迁移的UIE范式具有理论合理性和有效性，避免了伪标签噪声问题，为水下图像增强提供了一种新的可行路径。
AI.abstract_zh: 水下图像是在多种水质条件下拍摄的，导致复杂的退化问题，包括颜色偏色、低对比度和模糊效应。近年来，基于学习的方法已展现出在水下图像增强（UIE）中的潜力。然而，大多数前期工作聚焦于训练策略或网络设计，使得增强结果与数据集中的标签更好对齐，忽略了这些标签是从先前UIE方法的增强结果中选取的，且此类伪标签存在噪声。因此，其模型性能在一定程度上不尽如人意。然而，收集水下图像的真实标签极具挑战性。本文提出一种基于迁移学习的UIE方法，无需水下图像配备成对的噪声标签或真实标签即可学习。具体而言，首先依据水下物理原理将UIE任务分解为全局颜色校正、去雾和背景噪声抑制三个子步骤；然后在每个步骤中利用来自其他视觉任务的多种先验知识作为跨域监督。由此，通过迁移学习实现了一种新颖的UIE方法，且基于物理的UIE分解提供了理论上的合理性。定性和定量实验表明，我们提出的基于物理与先验融合的方法在UIE任务上达到了SOTA性能，并能有效提升下游视觉任务，显著优于基准方法。项目代码：https://github.com/Haru2022/P2-UIE。

title: LLM-Powered Virtual Population for Demand Simulation and Pricing
summary: We develop an LLM-powered virtual population model that simulates demand for pricing decisions, in settings where products are described by rich unstructured information, such as text descriptions and images, and where decision makers need not only mean-demand predictions but also uncertainty estimates for counterfactual prices. Our model represents exposed customers as draws from a finite mixture of customer personas. For each persona, product, and candidate price, an LLM elicits a persona-level purchase probability using both structured persona information and unstructured product information. These probabilities are aggregated through calibrated mixture weights to form a predictive distribution of aggregate demand. The resulting simulator can evaluate counterfactual prices under various pricing objectives, including expected revenue and risk-aware criteria such as conditional value at risk. We test the framework on an online H&M fashion dataset with product descriptions and images. The calibrated LLM-based simulator achieves the best overall predictive performance among the models considered, and supports sample-efficient pricing decisions. Our framework provides a practical way to use LLMs as demand simulators for products with limited historical demand data but rich product information. By producing a full predictive demand distribution rather than only a point forecast, it enables managers to compare candidate prices, quantify demand uncertainty, and choose prices that target either average-case revenue or risk-aware objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的虚拟人口模型，通过有限混合客户画像模拟需求，用于定价决策。该模型利用LLM生成画像级购买概率，经校准聚合形成需求预测分布，支持期望收益和风险-aware定价目标。在H&M时尚数据集上表现最优，且样本效率高。
AI.motivation: 在具有丰富非结构化信息（如文本描述和图像）但历史需求数据有限的产品定价场景中，现有方法难以同时提供反事实价格的均值预测和不确定性估计。本文旨在利用LLM构建一个既能进行准确需求预测又能量化不确定性的虚拟人口仿真器。
AI.method: 将客户表示为有限混合客户画像的随机采样；对每个画像、产品和候选价格，LLM利用结构化画像信息和非结构化产品信息生成画像级购买概率；通过校准后的混合权重聚合这些概率，形成总需求的预测概率分布。
AI.result: 在H&M时尚数据集上，基于LLM的校准仿真器在所有对比模型中取得了最佳整体预测性能，并支持样本高效的定价决策。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个实用的框架，将LLM用作需求仿真器，尤其适用于历史需求数据有限但产品信息丰富的场景。通过生成完整的需求预测分布而非单一点预测，使管理者能够比较候选价格、量化需求不确定性，并针对平均收益或风险-aware目标选择定价策略。
AI.abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的虚拟人口模型，用于模拟定价决策中的需求。该模型适用于产品由丰富非结构化信息（如文本描述和图像）描述的场景，且决策者不仅需要均值需求预测，还需要反事实价格的不确定性估计。我们的模型将暴露的客户表示为从有限混合客户画像中的随机采样。对于每个画像、产品和候选价格，LLM利用结构化画像信息和非结构化产品信息，生成画像级的购买概率。这些概率通过校准后的混合权重进行聚合，形成总需求的预测分布。由此得到的仿真器能够在各种定价目标下评估反事实价格，包括期望收益以及条件风险价值（CVaR）等风险-aware指标。我们在一个带有产品描述和图像的在线H&M时尚数据集上测试了该框架。基于LLM的校准仿真器在所有考虑模型中取得了最佳整体预测性能，并支持样本高效的定价决策。我们的框架提供了一种实用的方法，将LLM用作需求仿真器，适用于历史需求数据有限但产品信息丰富的场景。通过生成完整的需求预测分布而非仅仅点预测，该方法使管理者能够比较候选价格、量化需求不确定性，并针对平均收益或风险-aware目标选择定价。

title: Self-Questioning Vision-Language Models: Reinforcement Learning for Compositional Visual Reasoning
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are AI systems that process both images and text, yet they often struggle with compositional visual reasoning questions that require chaining multiple steps together, such as identifying objects, counting them, and comparing the results. Existing approaches improve this reasoning by training models on human-written step-by-step explanations, but creating these annotations is expensive and difficult to scale. We propose a self-questioning framework that trains a VLM to break visual questions into smaller sub-questions and answer each one before producing a final response, using a reinforcement learning algorithm called Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). The model is never shown examples of how to decompose questions, it discovers this behavior on its own, guided by a reward signal that scores whether the output contains sub-questions and whether the final answer is correct. We apply this framework to a 3-billion-parameter model, training on both synthetic scenes of geometric shapes (CLEVR) and real-world photographs (A-OKVQA). On A-OKVQA, both self-questioning and standard reinforcement learning substantially improve accuracy over the untrained model (52.2% and 51.6% vs. 46.8%). We introduce the first self-questioning VLM by rewarding not only the final answer like standard RL but additionally for generating intermediate sub-questions, enabling it to discover compositional decomposition strategies. These results suggest that teaching AI systems to ask themselves intermediate questions is a promising strategy for complex visual reasoning, particularly when the difficulty of a question warrants explicit step-by-step decomposition.

AI.tldr: 提出自问答框架，通过强化学习（GRPO）让VLM自主学会将复杂视觉问题分解为子问题并逐步解答，无需人工标注的步骤式解释，显著提升了组合视觉推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM在组合视觉推理（如识别、计数、比较的多步链式推理）上表现不佳，而人工编写逐步解释的标注成本高且难以扩展，因此需要一种无需人工示范、可自动学习的分解推理方法。
AI.method: 提出自问答框架，利用GRPO（组相对策略优化）强化学习算法训练VLM，奖励信号同时考量最终答案正确性和中间子问题生成行为，使模型自主学会将视觉问题分解为子问题并逐一回答，无需任何人工编写的分解示例。
AI.result: 在3B参数模型上，A-OKVQA数据集：自问答方法准确率52.2%，标准RL为51.6%，均显著优于未训练模型46.8%；在CLEVR合成场景上也进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 教会AI系统向自身提出中间问题是复杂视觉推理的一种有前景的策略，尤其当问题难度需要显式的逐步分解时，该方法比仅奖励最终答案的标准RL更有效。
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）是能够同时处理图像和文本的AI系统，但它们通常在需要多步链式推理的组合视觉推理问题上表现不佳，例如识别物体、计数并比较结果。现有方法通过训练模型使用人工编写的逐步解释来改进推理能力，但创建这些标注成本高昂且难以扩展。我们提出一个自问答框架，利用一种称为组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习算法，训练VLM将视觉问题分解为较小的子问题并在生成最终回答前逐一解答。模型从未见过如何分解问题的示例，而是自主发现这种行为，由奖励信号引导——该信号对输出中是否包含子问题以及最终答案是否正确进行评分。我们将该框架应用于一个30亿参数的模型，在合成几何场景（CLEVR）和真实世界照片（A-OKVQA）上进行了训练。在A-OKVQA上，自问答和标准强化学习相较于未训练模型均显著提升了准确率（分别为52.2%和51.6%，对比46.8%）。我们通过不仅像标准RL那样奖励最终答案，还额外奖励生成中间子问题，首次引入了自问答VLM，使其能够发现组合分解策略。这些结果表明，教会AI系统向自身提出中间问题是实现复杂视觉推理的一种有前景的策略，尤其当问题的难度需要显式的逐步分解时。

title: When Confidence Lacks Concepts: Interpretable OOD Detection via Representation Perturbations
summary: Deep neural networks have achieved remarkable performance across medical imaging tasks, yet their tendency to overgeneralize under distributional shifts poses a major obstacle to safe clinical deployment. Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection methods aim to mitigate this risk, but most existing approaches rely on opaque internal signals with poorly understood semantic meaning, limiting trust in safety-critical settings. In this work, we propose an interpretable OOD detection framework that probes the stability of model predictions under class-conditioned semantic perturbations. Leveraging sparse autoencoders (SAEs), we learn class-specific concept vectors from in-distribution data that disentangle dense intermediate representations into sparse, semantically meaningful components. At inference, we perturb deeper-layer representations using the concept vectors associated with the model's predicted class and measure the class logits stability. We hypothesize that in-distribution samples exhibit low sensitivity to such perturbations, as their representations align with class-specific semantic directions, whereas OOD samples show amplified deviations due to representational misalignment. By framing OOD detection as a concept conditioned stability analysis, our approach provides both a discriminative OOD signal and an interpretable lens into the internal mechanisms driving model uncertainty, making it particularly suitable for high stakes medical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于类条件语义扰动的可解释OOD检测框架，利用稀疏自编码器学习类特定概念向量，通过扰动深层表示并测量logits稳定性来区分分布内和OOD样本，兼具检测能力和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有OOD检测方法多依赖语义不明的内部信号，在安全关键的医疗场景中难以建立信任；需要一种既有效又具有可解释性的OOD检测方法。
AI.method: 使用稀疏自编码器从分布内数据中学习解耦的类特定概念向量；在推理时，用与模型预测类别对应的概念向量扰动深层表示，测量类别logits的稳定性；分布内样本对扰动不敏感，OOD样本则偏差放大。
AI.result: 该方法能提供区分性的OOD检测信号，同时揭示驱动模型不确定性的内部机制，适用于高风险医疗应用。
AI.conclusion: 将OOD检测建模为概念条件稳定性分析，既实现了有效的OOD判别，又提供了可解释性视角，特别适合高风险的医疗场景。
AI.abstract_zh: 深度神经网络在医学成像任务中取得了显著性能，但其在分布偏移下容易过度泛化的问题对安全临床部署构成了重大障碍。分布外（OOD）检测方法旨在缓解这一风险，但现有大多数方法依赖语义不明的黑箱内部信号，限制了在安全关键场景中的可信度。本文提出了一种可解释的OOD检测框架，通过探测模型在类条件语义扰动下的预测稳定性来识别OOD样本。借助稀疏自编码器（SAEs），我们从分布内数据中学习类特定概念向量，将稠密的中间表示解耦为稀疏且语义可解释的组件。在推理阶段，我们使用模型预测类别对应的概念向量扰动深层表示，并测量类别logits的稳定性。我们的假设是：分布内样本对此类扰动表现出低敏感性，因为其表示与类特定语义方向对齐；而OOD样本由于表示错位，会展现出放大的偏差。通过将OOD检测建模为概念条件稳定性分析，我们的方法既提供了具有判别力的OOD信号，又为理解驱动模型不确定性的内部机制提供了可解释的视角，使其特别适用于高风险的医疗应用。

title: SpatialAvatar-0: High-Quality 4D Head Avatar with Multi-Stage Reconstruction
summary: High-quality 4D head avatars from one or a few source portraits are central to telepresence, AR/VR, and digital-human interaction. 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has emerged as the dominant representation, with two complementary regimes (generalizable feed-forward predictors and per-subject refiners) maturing in parallel. However, existing feed-forward predictors are trained on a single dataset family with a hard-coded source count, inheriting the corresponding domain bias. Per-subject refiners require 300K--600K iterations and rely on adaptive densification that destroys upstream Gaussian layouts, preventing the two regimes from sharing a representation end-to-end. To bridge both regimes we propose SpatialAvatar-0 on a shared FLAME-mesh-bound Gaussian representation: a feed-forward generator with a parameter-free K-source mean-pool and a monocular-temporal to multi-view-spatial two-phase schedule that anchors against identity-prior collapse onto the smaller multi-view set. We further introduce a 10K-iter layout-preserving per-subject refinement loop that freezes the FLAME-binding and Gaussian count and replaces densification with a three-component anti-spike regularization. On VFHQ/HDTF cross-domain zero-shot we surpass the in-domain leader GAGAvatar by +1.5 dB PSNR despite never training on either test domain, and on the SplattingAvatar monocular benchmark we lead every reported metric, surpassing the 300K-iter GeoAvatar by +1.3 dB PSNR at up to 60x shorter per-subject schedule than common SOTA baselines. Website: https://spatialwalk.github.io/SpatialAvatar-0.

AI.tldr: 提出SpatialAvatar-0，通过共享FLAME网格绑定3D高斯表示，桥接前馈预测和逐主体精化两种范式，实现从单张或少量源肖像生成高质量4D头部头像，在跨域零样本和逐主体微调基准上均达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈预测器在单一数据集上训练且硬编码源图像数量，导致域偏置；逐主体精化方法需要30万-60万次迭代且依赖自适应稠密化，破坏了高斯布局，导致两种范式无法端到端共享表示。作者旨在弥合这两种范式。
AI.method: 1) 基于FLAME网格绑定的共享高斯表示；2) 前馈生成器：参数无关的K源均值池化 + 单目-时间到多视图-空间的两阶段调度，防止身份先验在小规模多视图集上坍缩；3) 10K迭代的布局保持逐主体精化循环：冻结FLAME绑定和高斯数量，用三组件抗尖峰正则化替代稠密化。
AI.result: 在VFHQ/HDTF跨域零样本上，虽未在测试域训练但仍超越域内领先方法GAGAvatar +1.5dB PSNR；在SplattingAvatar单目基准上各项指标领先，超越300K迭代的GeoAvatar +1.3dB PSNR，且逐主体调度比常见SOTA基线快60倍。
AI.conclusion: SpatialAvatar-0成功桥接了前馈预测与逐主体精化两种范式，在跨域泛化和高效精化方面均取得显著提升，验证了共享FLAME绑定高斯表示的有效性。
AI.abstract_zh: 高质量4D头部头像在远程临场、增强现实/虚拟现实以及数字人交互中至关重要。3D高斯泼溅已成为主导性表示，两种互补范式（可泛化的前馈预测器和逐主体精化器）正并行成熟。然而，现有的前馈预测器在单一数据集族上训练且使用硬编码的源图像数量，继承了相应的域偏置。逐主体精化器需要30万至60万次迭代，并依赖自适应稠密化，这破坏了上游的高斯布局，导致两种范式无法端到端共享同一表示。为弥合这两种范式，我们提出SpatialAvatar-0，基于共享的FLAME网格绑定高斯表示：一个前馈生成器，采用参数无关的K源均值池化，以及一个单目-时间到多视图-空间的两阶段调度，防止身份先验在较小的多视图集上坍缩。我们进一步引入仅需1万次迭代的布局保持逐主体精化循环，冻结FLAME绑定和高斯计数，用三组件抗尖峰正则化替代稠密化。在VFHQ/HDTF跨域零样本测试中，尽管从未在任一测试域上训练，我们仍以+1.5 dB PSNR超越域内领先方法GAGAvatar；在SplattingAvatar单目基准上，我们领先所有报告指标，以比常见SOTA基线快60倍的逐主体调度，超越需要30万次迭代的GeoAvatar +1.3 dB PSNR。网站：https://spatialwalk.github.io/SpatialAvatar-0。

title: Calibrated Sampling-Free Uncertainty Estimation in Bayesian Deep Learning
summary: Modern deep learning models remain notoriously prone to overconfidence, limiting their reliability in high-stakes applications. Bayesian methods aim to counter this by learning a distribution over model parameters, and recent advances now make this feasible for large-scale architectures at costs comparable to AdamW. However, a challenge remains at test time: predictions must be averaged across many forward passes with weights sampled from the posterior, which is prohibitively expensive. Variance propagation offers an efficient alternative, computing layer-wise analytical approximations of uncertainty in a single forward pass. While such techniques are effective for MLPs, their extension to modern architectures remains challenging, due to increased depth and diversity of layer types. To fill this gap, we propose Calibrated Variance Propagation (CVP), which introduces a new propagation method for normalization layers, combines it with recent techniques for handling activation functions, and absorbs residual error through a light calibration step. CVP yields comparably accurate uncertainty estimates to MC sampling across transformers and CNNs, at a fraction of the cost. Against prior variance propagation work, CVP improves coverage at $0.5\%$ risk from $8.2\%$ to $14.6\%$ with BEiT-3 on Visual Reasoning (NLVR2) and from $2.6\%$ to $10.8\%$ with ViLT on VQAv2, with gains extending to convolutional architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出校准方差传播（CVP），一种单次前向传播中高效传播不确定性的方法，将方差传播技术扩展到包含归一化层和现代激活函数的深度架构（Transformer和CNN），以极低成本达到与MC采样相当的校准效果。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习模型存在过度自信问题，贝叶斯方法虽能缓解但测试时需多次前向传播采样，计算成本过高；已有的方差传播方法虽高效但仅适用于MLP，难以扩展到包含多种复杂层类型的现代深度架构。
AI.method: 提出校准方差传播（CVP），包含三个关键组件：（1）为归一化层设计新的方差传播方法；（2）结合现有处理激活函数的方差传播技术；（3）通过轻量级校准步骤吸收残差误差，实现单次前向传播中的不确定性估计。
AI.result: 在Transformer和CNN架构上，CVP的不确定性估计精度与MC采样相当，但计算成本大幅降低。相较于先前方差传播方法，CVP在BEiT-3（NLVR2）上将0.5%风险下的覆盖率从8.2%提升至14.6%，在ViLT（VQAv2）上从2.6%提升至10.8%，卷积架构上同样有增益。
AI.conclusion: CVP成功将方差传播技术推广到现代深度架构，以单次前向传播的低成本实现了与MC采样媲美的不确定性估计，显著改善了模型校准性能。
AI.abstract_zh: 现代深度学习模型仍然以过度自信而闻名，这限制了它们在高风险应用中的可靠性。贝叶斯方法旨在通过学习模型参数的分布来应对这一问题，而最近的进展使得在大规模架构上以与AdamW相当的成本实现这一目标成为可能。然而，测试时仍存在一个挑战：预测需要对从后验中采样的权重进行多次前向传播的平均，这一过程计算成本过高。方差传播提供了一种高效的替代方案，在单次前向传播中逐层计算不确定性的解析近似。尽管这类技术对MLP有效，但由于现代架构深度增加且层类型多样，将其扩展到这些架构仍然具有挑战性。为填补这一空白，我们提出了校准方差传播（Calibrated Variance Propagation, CVP），该方法引入了一种新的归一化层传播方法，结合了现有的处理激活函数的技术，并通过轻量级校准步骤吸收残差误差。CVP在Transformer和CNN上产生的 uncertainty 估计与MC采样相当，而成本仅为其一小部分。相较于先前方差传播工作，CVP在BEiT-3的视觉推理任务（NLVR2）上将0.5%风险下的覆盖率从8.2%提升至14.6%，在ViLT的VQAv2任务上从2.6%提升至10.8%，且增益扩展到了卷积架构。

title: OneFocus: Enabling Real-World X-ray Security Screening with a Unified Vision-Language Model
summary: X-ray contraband detection is critical for security in large-scale logistics and transportation, yet conventional detectors struggle to adapt to emerging contraband types and lack fundamental visual understanding. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer strong generalization but are hindered by the scarcity of high-quality X-ray image-caption data. To bridge this critical gap, we present MMXray, a meticulously curated benchmark of 52,124 image-caption pairs spanning 28 fine-grained classes of X-ray contraband. To enrich MMXray with realistic occlusion patterns, we further introduce CleanDET, a dedicated synthesis dataset containing clean foreground contraband images from 28 categories and background images with diverse density levels, together with AnyContraSyn, a controllable synthesis method designed to operate on CleanDET. We also develop OnePipe, an extensible pipeline for systematic data curation. Built on MMXray, we propose OneFocus, a unified VLM that supports four core tasks: visual question answering, contraband localization, classification, and image understanding. OneFocus achieves state-of-the-art performance in X-ray contraband understanding and demonstrates robust cross-domain generalization, establishing a strong vision-language baseline for security screening.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MMXray基准数据集、CleanDET合成数据集、AnyContraSyn可控合成方法、OnePipe系统化数据整理流程以及基于MMXray训练的统一视觉语言模型OneFocus，在X光违禁品检测领域实现了四项核心任务的最优性能，并展现出强大的跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有X光违禁品检测方法难以适应新型违禁品种类，缺乏基础视觉理解能力；而视觉语言模型虽泛化能力强，但受限于缺乏高质量的X光图像-文本标注数据。
AI.method: 1) 构建MMXray基准数据集（52,124个图文对，28个细粒度违禁品类）；2) 提出CleanDET合成数据集（含28类干净前景违禁品图像及不同密度背景图像）和AnyContraSyn可控合成方法；3) 开发OnePipe可扩展系统化数据整理流程；4) 提出OneFocus统一VLM，支持视觉问答、违禁品定位、分类和图像理解四项核心任务。
AI.result: OneFocus在X光违禁品理解任务上达到了最先进性能，并展现出稳健的跨领域泛化能力，为安检建立了强大的视觉语言基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过构建高质量基准数据集和可控合成方法，统一视觉语言模型能够有效提升X光违禁品检测的理解能力和泛化性能，为安检领域提供了新的范式。
AI.abstract_zh: X光违禁品检测对于大规模物流和运输中的安全至关重要，然而传统检测器难以适应新兴的违禁品种类且缺乏基本的视觉理解能力。视觉语言模型（VLM）具有较强的泛化能力，但受到缺乏高质量X光图像-文本标注数据的限制。为弥合这一关键差距，我们提出了MMXray，这是一个精心整理的基准数据集，包含52,124个图像-文本对，涵盖28个细粒度类别的X光违禁品。为了赋予MMXray逼真的遮挡模式，我们进一步引入了CleanDET，这是一个专用的合成数据集，包含来自28个类别的干净前景违禁品图像和具有不同密度层次的背景图像，以及AnyContraSyn，一种基于CleanDET的可控合成方法。我们还开发了OnePipe，一个可扩展的系统化数据整理流程。基于MMXray，我们提出了OneFocus，一个统一的VLM，支持四项核心任务：视觉问答、违禁品定位、分类和图像理解。OneFocus在X光违禁品理解任务上取得了最先进的性能，并展现出稳健的跨领域泛化能力，为安检建立了强大的视觉语言基线。

title: Prediction of Runtime Parameters of Parallel Chemistry Applications via Active and Generative Learning
summary: In this work, we develop two main Machine Learning based approaches to predict the runtime parameters of highly scalable parallel chemistry computations.These approaches employ active and generative learning together with the empirically determined gradient boosted regression tree models chosen among a rich suite of machine learning models. When evaluated on Coupled-Cluster with Singles and Doubles computations, our models achieve a mean absolute error percentage (MAPE) as low as 0.023 and a coefficient of determination as high as 99.9%. Furthermore, when combined with active learning to mitigate the lack of large amounts of training data, our models score a MAPE about 0.2 with 20-25% of the original dataset.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了两种基于机器学习的方法，结合主动学习与生成学习，使用梯度提升回归树模型预测高可扩展并行化学计算的运行时参数，在CCSD计算上MAPE低至0.023，R²高达99.9%。
AI.motivation: 针对高可扩展并行化学计算中运行时参数预测困难以及训练数据匮乏的问题，提出有效的机器学习预测方法。
AI.method: 采用主动学习和生成学习相结合的策略，从丰富的机器学习模型套件中选取经验确定的梯度提升回归树模型，用于预测并行化学计算的运行时参数。
AI.result: 在Coupled-Cluster with Singles and Doubles (CCSD) 计算上，模型MAPE低至0.023，决定系数高达99.9%；结合主动学习后，仅使用20-25%的原始数据集即可达到约0.2的MAPE。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的机器学习方法能够高效且准确地预测并行化学计算运行时参数，主动学习策略有效缓解了小样本数据下的训练问题。
AI.abstract_zh: 在本工作中，我们开发了两种基于机器学习的主要方法，用于预测高可扩展并行化学计算的运行时参数。这些方法采用主动学习和生成学习，并结合从丰富的机器学习模型套件中经验确定的梯度提升回归树模型。在耦合簇 singles 和 doubles 计算上的评估表明，我们的模型实现了低至0.023的平均绝对误差百分比（MAPE）以及高达99.9%的决定系数。此外，当结合主动学习以缓解大规模训练数据缺乏的问题时，我们的模型仅使用原始数据集的20-25%即可达到约0.2的MAPE。

title: CEVAR: Centerline Embedding Extraction for Endovascular Aneurysm Repair
summary: Long-term mortality rates after endovascular aneurysm repair (EVAR) remain elevated due to post-EVAR rupture caused by loss of seal in stent graft sealing zones. Structured CT review using centerline measurements improves detection, but current workflows require manual centerline editing and expert operators. We propose a transformer framework for automated, protocol-driven sealing zone assessment that combines 3D centerline tracking with embedding-based geometric prediction. Two state-of-the-art image-to-graph models are evaluated for aorto-iliac centerline extraction from follow-up CT and for measurement of stent position, vessel diameters, and seal lengths according to EVAR4C protocol. Across the full test set and a challenging no-contrast subset, the proposed fully automatic method outperforms the commercial semi-automatic workflow.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于Transformer的全自动框架，用于主动脉-髂动脉支架术后密封区评估，结合三维中心线追踪与嵌入几何预测，在标准和无对比CT子集上均优于商用半自动方法。
AI.motivation: 血管内动脉瘤修复术(EVAR)后远期死亡率仍较高，主要原因是支架移植物密封区失效导致的术后破裂。现有基于中心线测量的结构化CT评估虽能改进检测，但依赖手动编辑和专家操作，亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出一个Transformer框架，结合3D中心线追踪与基于嵌入的几何预测，实现自动化、协议驱动的密封区评估。采用两种图像到图(state-of-the-art)模型，用于从随访CT中提取主动脉-髂动脉中心线，并根据EVAR4C协议测量支架位置、血管直径和密封长度。
AI.result: 在完整测试集和具有挑战性的无对比子集上，所提出的全自动方法均优于商用半自动工作流程。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的全自动密封区评估框架无需手动编辑和专家操作，即可实现优于半自动方法的性能，有望降低EVAR术后远期死亡率。
AI.abstract_zh: 血管内动脉瘤修复术（EVAR）后的远期死亡率仍然较高，原因是支架移植物密封区失效导致的术后破裂。采用中心线测量的结构化CT复查可改善检测效果，但当前工作流程需要手动调整中心线和专家操作。我们提出一个基于Transformer的自动化、协议驱动式密封区评估框架，该框架将3D中心线追踪与基于嵌入的几何预测相结合。评估了两种当前最优的图像到图模型，用于从随访CT中提取主动脉-髂动脉中心线，并根据EVAR4C协议测量支架位置、血管直径和密封长度。在完整测试集以及具有挑战性的无对比子集上，所提出的全自动方法均优于商用半自动工作流程。

title: From Tokens to Regions: CUDA-Sensitive Instruction Tuning for GPU Kernel Generation
summary: High-performance CUDA kernels are essential for scalable AI systems, while Large Language Models (LLMs) still struggle to generate correct kernels due to strict and implicit execution constraints. Existing LLM-based approaches either rely on costly agentic or reinforcement-learning (RL) pipelines, or adopt supervised fine-tuning (SFT) objectives that fail to explicitly model CUDA sensitivity, namely code tokens or regions tightly coupled with execution constraints. In this work, we investigate CUDA sensitivity from the perspective of token confidence patterns, showing that CUDA sensitivity appears at both token and region levels, where most CUDA-sensitive tokens are predicted with high confidence, while a smaller low-confidence subset forms regions corresponding to execution-critical structures. These findings suggest that effective CUDA kernel generation should both leverage high-confidence CUDA-sensitive tokens and preserve low-confidence CUDA-sensitive regions. Building on these insights, we propose \textbf{\underline{CU}DA-\underline{Se}nsitive Instruction \underline{T}uning (CuSeT)}, a low-cost post-training method within a simple SFT framework. CuSeT follows the principle of ``from tokens to regions'' by combining \emph{adaptive token-level masking} with \emph{region-aware sample reweighting}. Experiments show that CuSeT consistently improves functional correctness across multiple model families and scales, outperforming standard SFT and advanced SFT variants, while achieving competitive performance against frontier CUDA kernel generation models with substantially lower inference cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CuSeT，一种低成本的后训练方法，通过自适应Token级掩码和区域感知样本重加权，在简单SFT框架内显著提升LLM生成高性能CUDA内核的功能正确性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成CUDA内核的方法要么依赖昂贵的学习管线（如强化学习或智能体方法），要么使用标准SFT目标但未能显式建模CUDA敏感性（即与执行约束紧密耦合的代码token或区域）。本文旨在探索一种低成本、高效率的后训练方法，显式处理CUDA敏感性以提升内核生成正确性。
AI.method: 提出CUDA敏感指令微调（CuSeT），遵循"从token到区域"原则，包含两个核心组件：(1) 自适应Token级掩码——利用高置信度的CUDA敏感token；(2) 区域感知样本重加权——保留对应执行关键结构的低置信度CUDA敏感区域。
AI.result: 实验表明CuSeT在多个模型家族和规模上一致提升了功能正确性，优于标准SFT及其高级变体；同时以显著更低的推理成本达到了与前沿CUDA内核生成模型竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过从token置信度模式角度分析CUDA敏感性，并设计相应的"从token到区域"训练策略，CuSeT在低成本条件下有效提升了LLM生成正确CUDA内核的能力，验证了显式建模CUDA敏感性的重要性。
AI.abstract_zh: 高性能CUDA内核对于可扩展的AI系统至关重要，而大型语言模型（LLM）由于严格且隐式的执行约束，仍然难以生成正确的内核。现有的基于LLM的方法要么依赖昂贵的智能体或强化学习管线，要么采用监督式微调（SFT）目标，但未能显式建模CUDA敏感性——即与执行约束紧密耦合的代码token或区域。在本工作中，我们从token置信度模式的角度研究CUDA敏感性，表明CUDA敏感性同时出现在token和区域层面：大多数CUDA敏感token以高置信度被预测，而少数低置信度子集则形成对应于执行关键结构的区域。这些发现表明，有效的CUDA内核生成应同时利用高置信度的CUDA敏感token并保留低置信度的CUDA敏感区域。基于这些见解，我们提出\textbf{\underline{CU}DA-\underline{Se}nsitive Instruction \underline{T}uning (CuSeT)}，一种在简单SFT框架内的低成本后训练方法。CuSeT遵循"从token到区域"的原则，结合了自适应token级掩码与区域感知样本重加权。实验表明，CuSeT在多个模型家族和规模上一致地提升了功能正确性，优于标准SFT及其高级变体，同时以显著更低的推理成本达到了与前沿CUDA内核生成模型竞争的性能。

title: 3D Consistency Optimization for Self-Supervised Monocular Video Depth Estimation
summary: Reliable monocular video depth estimation is crucial for downstream 3D reasoning and embodied AI in endoscopic navigation. However, existing self-supervised approaches typically treat video frames independently or rely on weak temporal regularization. These methods, lacking a holistic perception of the underlying 3D scene, inevitably suffer from geometrically inconsistent predictions and severe cross-frame drift. To address these limitations, we introduce a new paradigm that recasts sequential video depth estimation as an unconstrained multi-view 3D reconstruction problem, enabling full exploitation of the powerful geometric priors embedded in recent 3D foundation models. The core of our approach is a 3D consistency optimization framework driven by three constraints: image-level photometric rendering, explicit world-coordinate geometric alignment, and multi-scale temporal gradient consistency. Such unified optimization elegantly anchors isolated frames to a globally coherent 3D structure. Our method has been validated in both the self-supervised training scenarios and challenging zero-shot clinical environments. Results show that the proposed approach achieves state-of-the-art spatial accuracy, outperforming the frame-based, video-based depth estimators and the multi-view 3D reconstruction baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的自监督单目视频深度估计范式，将序列深度估计重构为无约束的多视图3D重建问题，通过3D一致性优化框架（包含光度渲染、几何对齐和时间梯度一致性三个约束）实现全局连贯的3D结构，在自监督训练和零样本临床环境中均取得最先进的空间精度。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督方法将视频帧独立处理或仅依赖弱时间正则化，缺乏对底层3D场景的整体感知，导致几何不一致的预测和严重的跨帧漂移。
AI.method: 将视频深度估计重新定义为无约束的多视图3D重建问题，利用3D基础模型的几何先验，通过3D一致性优化框架整合三个约束：图像级光度渲染、显式世界坐标几何对齐、多尺度时间梯度一致性，将孤立帧锚定到全局一致的3D结构上。
AI.result: 在自监督训练场景和零样本临床环境中均达到最先进的空间精度，优于基于帧的、基于视频的深度估计器以及多视图3D重建基线。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的范式有效解决了自监督视频深度估计中的几何不一致和跨帧漂移问题，通过全局3D结构的统一优化显著提升了空间准确性，并具备良好的零样本泛化能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 可靠的单目视频深度估计对于内窥镜导航中的下游3D推理和具身AI至关重要。然而，现有的自监督方法通常独立处理视频帧或仅依赖弱时间正则化。这些方法缺乏对底层3D场景的整体感知，不可避免地导致几何不一致的预测和严重的跨帧漂移。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种新范式，将序列视频深度估计重新定义为无约束的多视图3D重建问题，从而充分利用嵌入在近期3D基础模型中的强大几何先验。我们方法的核心是一个由三个约束驱动的3D一致性优化框架：图像级光度渲染、显式世界坐标几何对齐和多尺度时间梯度一致性。这种统一的优化巧妙地将孤立帧锚定到全局连贯的3D结构上。我们的方法已在自监督训练场景和具有挑战性的零样本临床环境中得到验证。结果表明，所提出的方法实现了最先进的空间精度，优于基于帧的、基于视频的深度估计器以及多视图3D重建基线。

title: Evolutionary Bilevel Reward Shaping for Generalization in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) often suffers from performance degradation when deployed in environments that differ from those encountered during training. Existing techniques such as domain randomization (DR) mitigate this, but require access to diverse training environments and full trajectory observability, assumptions that fail in privacy-preserving or restricted scenarios where only scalar performance metrics are available. We propose Generalization via Evolutionary Reward Shaping (GERS), a bilevel optimization approach to improve generalization on unseen test environments using only scalar feedback from validation environments. At the lower level, an RL agent guided via a reward function shaped by the upper level learns a policy on a limited set of training environments with accessible trajectory data; at the upper level, CMA-ES optimizes the reward shaping parameters to maximize the cumulative unshaped reward on separate validation environments for which trajectory access is unavailable. Results on continuous control tasks indicate that GERS outperforms the standard RL baseline on unseen test environments. GERS performance is comparable to DR, despite DR treating the combined set of training and validation environments of GERS as a single training set that requires trajectory access, whereas GERS cannot access validation trajectories. These results confirm that GERS effectively enhances generalization under restricted data access constraints.

AI.tldr: 提出GERS方法，通过双层优化在仅能获取标量性能指标的受限场景下提升强化学习在未见测试环境中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有域随机化等方法需要多样化的训练环境和完整的轨迹可观测性，但在隐私保护或受限场景下仅能获取标量性能指标，因此需要一种能在数据访问受限条件下提升泛化能力的方法。
AI.method: 采用双层优化框架：下层在可访问轨迹数据的训练集上，由上层塑造的奖励函数引导RL智能体学习策略；上层使用CMA-ES优化奖励塑造参数，最大化在无法获取轨迹的验证环境上的累计未塑造奖励。
AI.result: 在连续控制任务上，GERS在未见测试环境上优于标准RL基线；性能与域随机化相当，但域随机化将GERS的训练集和验证集合并作为需轨迹访问的训练集，而GERS无法访问验证轨迹。
AI.conclusion: GERS在数据访问受限条件下有效增强了强化学习的泛化能力。
AI.abstract_zh: 强化学习在部署于训练时未遇到的环境时，往往会出现性能下降。现有技术如域随机化（DR）可以缓解这一问题，但需要访问多样化的训练环境和完整的轨迹可观测性，这些假设在隐私保护或受限场景中无法成立，因为此时只能获取标量性能指标。本文提出基于进化奖励塑造的泛化方法（GERS），这是一种双层优化方法，仅使用来自验证环境的标量反馈提升在未见测试环境上的泛化能力。下层中，由上层塑造的奖励函数引导的RL智能体在有限的可访问轨迹数据的训练集上学习策略；上层中，CMA-ES优化奖励塑造参数，以最大化在无法获取轨迹的独立验证环境上的累计未塑造奖励。连续控制任务上的结果表明，GERS在未见测试环境上优于标准RL基线。尽管DR将GERS的训练集和验证集合并作为需要轨迹访问的单一训练集，而GERS无法访问验证轨迹，但GERS的性能与DR相当。这些结果证实，GERS在数据访问受限条件下有效增强了泛化能力。

title: OmniTraffic: A Controllable Generation Pipeline and Benchmark for Spatio-Temporal Traffic Reasoning
summary: Traffic scene understanding requires models to reason beyond object recognition, including lane topology, multi-view geometry, temporal evolution, and signal-phase semantics. However, existing traffic-oriented multimodal benchmarks largely emphasize passive visual recognition or isolated video understanding, offering limited support for evaluating structure-aware traffic reasoning under controlled conditions. We introduce OmniTraffic, a controllable generation pipeline and benchmark for spatio-temporal traffic reasoning. Built around 12 real-world intersections reconstructed into editable 3D traffic environments and complemented by surveillance footage from two countries, OmniTraffic supports both controlled and natural-condition evaluation. It defines a three-level task hierarchy spanning scene perception, multi-view and temporal reasoning, and decision support. Using structured traffic metadata, OmniTraffic generates synchronized multi-view VQA samples covering vehicle states, lane functions, view--BEV correspondence, temporal dynamics, and signal-phase analysis, resulting in 8M VQA samples and a 3K human-verified test set. Evaluation of eleven frontier MLLMs reveals a large human--model gap, with the most pronounced failures in topology-grounded and spatio-temporal reasoning tasks. Fine-tuning a lightweight MLLM on simulated OmniTraffic data further improves performance on real-world traffic scenes, demonstrating the value of simulation-generated supervision for traffic-specific multimodal reasoning. Beyond a fixed dataset, OmniTraffic provides an extensible pipeline with configurable intersections, camera views, traffic demands, signal phases, visual conditions, and rare events.

AI.tldr: OmniTraffic是一个面向交通场景的时空推理可控生成管道与基准，通过12个真实路口构建的可编辑3D环境生成800万VQA样本，评估11个前沿多模态大模型发现人-模型差距显著，微调轻量模型可提升真实场景性能。
AI.motivation: 现有面向交通的多模态基准大多侧重于被动视觉识别或孤立的视频理解，缺乏在受控条件下评估结构化交通推理（如车道拓扑、多视角几何、时序演变、信号相位语义）的能力。
AI.method: 基于12个真实路口构建可编辑3D交通环境，结合两国监控视频，利用结构化交通元数据生成同步多视角VQA样本（含车辆状态、车道功能、视角-BEV对应、时序动态、信号相位分析），共800万VQA样本和3000个人工验证测试集。
AI.result: 评估11个前沿多模态大语言模型，发现人类与模型之间存在巨大差距，最明显的失败出现在拓扑基础和时空推理任务上；在模拟的OmniTraffic数据上微调轻量MLLM可提升其在真实交通场景上的性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniTraffic不仅是一个固定数据集，更提供了可扩展的管道，支持可配置的路口、相机视角、交通需求、信号相位、视觉条件和罕见事件，验证了仿真生成监督对交通专用多模态推理的价值。
AI.abstract_zh: 交通场景理解要求模型推理能力超越目标识别，涵盖车道拓扑、多视角几何、时序演变和信号相位语义。然而，现有面向交通的多模态基准大多强调被动视觉识别或孤立的视频理解，对在受控条件下评估结构化交通推理的支持有限。我们提出了OmniTraffic，一个面向时空交通推理的可控生成管道与基准。该框架基于12个真实世界路口重建为可编辑的3D交通环境，并辅以来自两个国家的监控视频，同时支持受控和自然条件评估。OmniTraffic定义了涵盖场景感知、多视角与时序推理以及决策支持的三级任务层次。利用结构化交通元数据，OmniTraffic生成同步的多视角VQA样本，覆盖车辆状态、车道功能、视角-鸟瞰图对应、时序动态和信号相位分析，共计800万VQA样本和3000个人工验证的测试集。对11个前沿多模态大语言模型的评估揭示了人类与模型之间的巨大差距，最明显的失败出现在拓扑基础和时空推理任务上。在模拟的OmniTraffic数据上微调轻量MLLM，进一步提升了其在真实交通场景上的性能，证明了仿真生成监督对交通专用多模态推理的价值。超越固定数据集，OmniTraffic提供了可扩展的管道，支持可配置的路口、相机视角、交通需求、信号相位、视觉条件和罕见事件。

title: Rapid Poison: Practical Poisoning Attacks Against the Rapid Response Framework
summary: The Rapid Response (RR) framework, deployed in production systems, including Anthropic's ASL-3 safeguards, continuously improves jailbreak-detection classifiers. When new jailbreaks emerge that bypass these classifiers, Rapid Response generates synthetic variants for training, helping the model generalize from the new attacks and quickly adapt. We reveal that prompt injection can infiltrate this pipeline to deliver poisoned samples into the classifier's training set, enabling two attack objectives: (I) targeted poisoning attacks that create false positives on harmless samples by categorizing them as a jailbreak, with a specific desired feature (e.g., certain formatting, subject, or keyword), (II) concept-based backdoor attacks that induce false negatives on jailbreak inputs, generalizing even to jailbreaks from attack strategies the defender explicitly trained against, when the backdoor trigger is present. Importantly, our threat model restricts adversaries to modifying only jailbreak samples (not benign data or labels), a constraint unexplored by prior work that makes the second objective particularly challenging. We address this with Omission Attack, which exploits a new phenomenon: when training on concept-absent unsafe samples, the classifier misassociates that concept's presence with the safe label. Both attacks cause substantial and in some cases near-complete label flipping at only a 1% poisoning rate, achieving up to 100% false positive rates and up to 96% false negative rates.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了生产级快速响应（RR）框架（如Anthropic的ASL-3防护）存在提示注入漏洞，攻击者可通过修改越狱样本注入有毒数据，实现两种攻击目标：针对无害样本的定向投毒攻击（产生假阳性）和基于概念的后门攻击（对含触发器的越狱输入产生假阴性）。在仅1%投毒率下，攻击可达100%假阳性率和96%假阴性率。
AI.motivation: 现有工作未探索攻击者仅能修改越狱样本（不能修改良性数据或标签）这一威胁模型下的投毒攻击可能性，尤其是诱导假阴性的后门攻击在此约束下极具挑战性。作者旨在揭示RR框架的安全漏洞并展示其严重性。
AI.method: 提出Omission Attack（遗漏攻击）：利用当训练集中存在概念缺失的不安全样本时，分类器会错误地将该概念的存在与安全标签关联起来这一新现象，实现概念级后门攻击。同时实现定向投毒攻击，在无害样本上制造假阳性。
AI.result: 在仅1%投毒率下，两种攻击均造成显著乃至近乎完全的标签翻转：假阳性率达100%，假阴性率高达96%。
AI.conclusion: 生产级RR防御框架存在严重的投毒攻击风险，攻击者仅通过修改越狱样本即可高效破坏分类器。现有防御机制需要加强对训练数据投毒攻击的防护。
AI.abstract_zh: 快速响应（RR）框架已部署于生产系统（包括Anthropic的ASL-3防护措施），可持续改进越狱检测分类器。当新出现的越狱攻击绕过这些分类器时，RR会生成合成变体用于训练，帮助模型从新型攻击中泛化并快速适应。本文揭示：提示注入可渗透该流水线，将有毒样本注入分类器的训练集，从而实现两种攻击目标：（I）定向投毒攻击，在无害样本上产生假阳性（将其错误分类为越狱），且具有特定的期望特征（如特定格式、主题或关键词）；（II）基于概念的后门攻击，在存在后门触发器时，对越狱输入诱导假阴性，甚至能泛化到防御方明确训练对抗的攻击策略所生成的越狱样本。值得注意的是，我们的威胁模型限制攻击者仅能修改越狱样本（不能修改良性数据或标签），这一约束未被先前工作探索，使得第二个目标尤其具有挑战性。我们通过遗漏攻击（Omission Attack）来解决这一问题，该攻击利用一个新现象：当在概念缺失的不安全样本上训练时，分类器会错误地将该概念的存在与安全标签关联起来。两种攻击在仅1%的投毒率下均造成显著乃至近乎完全的标签翻转，假阳性率高达100%，假阴性率高达96%。

title: The Circumplex Degeneracy Behind the Rare-Class Limit in Affect Recognition
summary: In-the-wild expression recognition persistently fails on a few rare emotions, and the standard explanation is class imbalance. Through a controlled multi-task study on two benchmarks, we show the failure is instead a property of affect geometry: the rare classes are degenerate on Russell's circumplex, and that degeneracy bounds what any loss or cost can achieve. Our instrument is a circumplex-cost optimal-transport term that prices expression confusions by their valence-arousal distance. The term improves the official score and expression macro-F1, but a control most studies omit shows the gain is not geometric: a uniform cost, equivalent to a generic confidence penalty, matches it on Aff-Wild2 (p=0.625) and significantly exceeds it on AffectNet (+0.057 over base, larger than the circumplex). What the geometry reshapes is the structure of the errors, making them affectively nearer the truth on Aff-Wild2 (p=0.031 against the uniform control), an effect that does not survive on AffectNet, where a visual confound at the far corner of the circumplex overwhelms it. The rare-class failure, by contrast, is stable across both datasets we examine: the degenerate pairs (anger-fear on Aff-Wild2, anger-contempt on AffectNet) resist frequency-based interventions, the transport term, and an action-unit-augmented cost built specifically to separate them. We conclude that progress on rare expressions requires representations that distinguish the classes, not supervision that reprices their confusions, and we provide the controls and metrics needed to tell the two apart.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示野外表情识别中稀有情绪类别的失败并非源于类别不平衡，而是情感几何结构的退化属性（稀有类别在Russell环状模型中退化），并证明当前基于损失或代价的干预方法无法解决该问题，需要从根本上改进类别表征。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将稀有情绪识别失败归因于类别不平衡，但作者通过对照多任务实验发现，真正的根本原因是情感几何结构问题——稀有类别在Russell的环状模型（valence-arousal二维空间）上存在退化性，这种退化限制了任何损失函数或代价函数的效果。
AI.method: 提出环状代价最优传输项（circumplex-cost optimal-transport term），通过valence-arousal距离对表情混淆进行定价；同时设置统一代价（uniform cost）作为对照——后者等价于通用的置信度惩罚项，用于区分几何效应与非几何效应。
AI.result: 环状代价项提升了官方评分和宏F1，但统一代价在Aff-Wild2上与之无显著差异（p=0.625），在AffectNet上甚至显著超过环状代价（比基线高0.057）。几何代价主要重塑了错误结构，使Aff-Wild2上的预测在情感空间上更接近真实标签（p=0.031），但该效应在AffectNet上不成立（视觉混淆因素占主导）。稀有类别失败在两组数据集上稳定存在：退化类别对（Aff-Wild2上的anger-fear，AffectNet上的anger-contempt）抵抗频率干预、最优传输项以及专门设计的AU增强代价。
AI.conclusion: 稀有表情识别的进步需要能够区分这些类别的表征，而不是通过重新定价混淆来干预的监督信号；同时提供了区分两者所需的对照实验设置和评估指标。
AI.abstract_zh: 野外表情识别在少数稀有情绪上持续失败，标准的解释是类别不平衡。通过两个基准数据集上的受控多任务研究，我们发现失败实际上是情感几何结构的一个属性：稀有类别在Russell环状模型上呈退化状态，这种退化限制了任何损失或代价所能达到的效果。我们的工具是一个环状代价最优传输项，通过效价-唤醒度距离对表情混淆进行定价。该项提升了官方评分和表情宏F1，但一个大多数研究遗漏的对照实验表明，这种提升并非几何性的：统一代价（等价于通用置信度惩罚项）在Aff-Wild2上与之匹配（p=0.625），在AffectNet上显著超过它（比基线高0.057，大于环状代价）。几何代价所重塑的是错误的结构，使其在Aff-Wild2上的情感预测更接近真实值（相对于统一对照的p=0.031），但这种效应在AffectNet上未能保持——环状模型远角处的视觉混淆因素压倒了它。相比之下，稀有类别的失败在我们考察的两个数据集上均是稳定的：退化类别对（Aff-Wild2上的愤怒-恐惧，AffectNet上的愤怒-轻蔑）抵抗基于频率的干预、传输项以及专门为分离它们而构建的动作单元增强代价。我们得出结论：稀有表情识别的进展需要能够区分这些类别的表征，而不是重新定价其混淆的监督信号，并且我们提供了区分这两者所需的对照实验和评估指标。

title: LiFT: Local Search via Linear Programming for Overfitting-Controlled Transformers
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, published in The 20th Learning and Intelligent Optimization Conference (LION 2026)
summary: This paper proposes a Linear Programming (LP)-based local search framework for fine-tuning pretrained transformer models with explicit control against overfitting. The approach formulates transformer fine-tuning as a bilevel optimization-based regularization problem, in which model parameters and regularization hyperparameters are jointly updated. Information collected during initial warm-up iterations, including validation gradients and training Hessian information, is used to construct a local descent direction by solving an LP that minimizes a scaled directional derivative while preserving training optimality. This validation-aware descent direction enables focused local updates of both parameters and regularization hyperparameters, reducing overfitting without requiring repeated full retraining cycles. The resulting method, termed Linear Programming-based Fine-Tuning (LiFT) for transformers, differs from conventional fine-tuning by systematically identifying task-specific updates rather than relying on heuristic or grid-based hyperparameter selection. Experiments on GPT-2 Small fine-tuned on WikiText-2 demonstrate that LiFT enables effective adaptation through selective tuning of transformer blocks and regularization parameters, yielding consistent improvements in test perplexity across multiple layer configurations and regularization settings, with particularly pronounced gains in overfitting-prone scenarios. Beyond empirical performance, LiFT establishes a principled connection between transformer fine-tuning, bilevel optimization, local search, and regularization theory.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于线性规划（LP）的局部搜索框架（LiFT），用于对预训练Transformer模型进行微调，通过联合优化模型参数和正则化超参数实现显式的过拟合控制。
AI.motivation: 传统Transformer微调方法依赖启发式或网格搜索选择超参数，容易导致过拟合，且缺乏系统性的理论指导。本文旨在建立一种有理论依据的微调方法，在避免重复全量训练的同时有效控制过拟合。
AI.method: 将Transformer微调建模为双层优化正则化问题，在初始热身迭代中收集验证梯度和训练Hessian信息，通过求解一个线性规划来构造局部下降方向，该方向在保持训练最优性的同时最小化缩放方向导数，从而联合更新模型参数和正则化超参数。
AI.result: 在GPT-2 Small模型上使用WikiText-2数据集进行实验，LiFT通过选择性微调Transformer块和正则化参数，在多种层配置和正则化设置下均能持续改善测试困惑度，尤其在容易过拟合的场景中提升显著。
AI.conclusion: LiFT在Transformer微调、双层优化、局部搜索和正则化理论之间建立了原则性联系，提供了一种比传统启发式方法更系统、更有效的过拟合控制微调框架。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于线性规划（LP）的局部搜索框架，用于对预训练Transformer模型进行微调，并实现显式的过拟合控制。该方法将Transformer微调建模为一个基于双层优化的正则化问题，其中模型参数和正则化超参数被联合更新。在初始热身迭代期间收集的信息，包括验证梯度和训练Hessian信息，被用于通过求解一个线性规划来构造局部下降方向，该线性规划在保持训练最优性的同时最小化缩放方向导数。这种对验证集敏感的下降方向使得能够对参数和正则化超参数进行聚焦式局部更新，在无需重复完整再训练周期的情况下减少过拟合。由此产生的针对Transformer的方法称为LiFT（Linear Programming-based Fine-Tuning），它通过系统性地识别任务特定更新来区别于传统的微调方法，而非依赖启发式或网格搜索的超参数选择。在GPT-2 Small模型上使用WikiText-2数据集进行微调的实验表明，LiFT通过对Transformer块和正则化参数进行选择性调优实现有效适配，在多种层配置和正则化设置下均能持续改善测试困惑度，尤其在容易过拟合的场景中增益显著。除了实证性能外，LiFT还在Transformer微调、双层优化、局部搜索和正则化理论之间建立了原则性联系。

title: Task-Instructed Causal Routing of Vision Foundation Models for Multi-Task Learning
summary: Vision foundation models (VFMs) have demonstrated strong robustness and transferability across a wide range of visual tasks. However, each model typically encodes strong inductive biases shaped by its pre-training objective and data domain, resulting in fragmented yet complementary visual knowledge. As a result, a single model often struggles to capture the diverse visual representations required across multiple dense prediction tasks. To address this limitation, we propose TIGER (Task-Instruction-Guided Expert Routing), a framework that coordinates multiple heterogeneous VFMs for multi-task dense prediction. Instead of naively aggregating expert features, TIGER leverages natural-language task instructions to guide a routing network that assigns token-level expert weights conditioned on task semantics, enabling adaptive integration of complementary expert features. TIGER further introduces a counterfactual loss that aligns routing decisions with each expert's causal contribution by measuring prediction changes when experts are excluded, encouraging more reliable and interpretable routing. We evaluate TIGER on two multi-task dense prediction benchmarks, NYUD-v2 and Pascal Context, where it consistently outperforms recent multi-task learning baselines while keeping all VFMs frozen. These results demonstrate that combining instruction-guided expert routing with counterfactual causal alignment enables effective coordination of heterogeneous vision foundation models.

AI.tldr: TIGER提出了一种任务指令引导的专家路由框架，通过自然语言指令和反事实因果对齐，协调多个异构视觉基础模型完成多任务密集预测，在NYUD-v2和Pascal Context上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 单个视觉基础模型因预训练目标和数据域的不同而编码了强归纳偏置，导致视觉知识碎片化且互补，单一模型难以同时捕捉多种密集预测任务所需的多样化视觉表征。
AI.method: 提出TIGER框架，核心包括：(1) 利用自然语言任务指令引导路由网络，为每个token分配任务语义相关的专家权重，实现自适应特征融合；(2) 引入反事实损失，通过移除专家后测量预测变化来对齐路由决策与每个专家的因果贡献，提升路由的可靠性和可解释性。
AI.result: 在两个多任务密集预测基准NYUD-v2和Pascal Context上，TIGER在保持所有视觉基础模型冻结的情况下，一致优于最新的多任务学习基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合指令引导的专家路由与反事实因果对齐，能够有效协调异构的视觉基础模型，实现多任务密集预测性能的提升。
AI.abstract_zh: 视觉基础模型（VFM）在广泛的视觉任务中展现了强大的鲁棒性和迁移能力。然而，每个模型通常由其预训练目标和数据域编码了强归纳偏置，导致视觉知识碎片化但互补。因此，单一模型往往难以捕获多个密集预测任务所需的各种视觉表征。为解决这一局限，我们提出TIGER（任务指令引导的专家路由），一个协调多个异构视觉基础模型进行多任务密集预测的框架。与简单聚合专家特征不同，TIGER利用自然语言任务指令引导一个路由网络，根据任务语义为每个token分配专家权重，从而实现互补专家特征的自适应集成。TIGER进一步引入一个反事实损失，通过测量排除专家时的预测变化，将路由决策与每个专家的因果贡献对齐，鼓励更可靠和可解释的路由。我们在两个多任务密集预测基准NYUD-v2和Pascal Context上评估TIGER，它在保持所有VFM冻结的情况下，一致优于最新的多任务学习基线。这些结果表明，结合指令引导的专家路由与反事实因果对齐能够有效协调异构的视觉基础模型。

title: Data Augmentations for Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining
summary: As AI labs approach a data ceiling where compute capacity outpaces the rate of new high-quality text generation, language model pretraining is shifting toward a data-constrained, compute-abundant regime that demands productive multi-epoch training on fixed corpora. Standard autoregressive (AR) pretraining overfits severely in this setting, reaching its optimum early and then continuously deteriorating. We investigate data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate this overfitting and enable productive training for hundreds of epochs on the same data. We introduce three orthogonal categories of augmentation for AR pretraining: token-level noise (masking, random replacement), sequence permutations (right-to-left prediction, Fill-in-the-Middle), and target offset prediction ($x_{t+i}$ for $i > 1$). Through systematic ablations, we find that individual augmentations delay overfitting and lower validation loss relative to the baseline, with random token replacement achieving the best minimum loss among individual methods. Combining augmentation categories further lowers the minimum validation loss. Our experiments demonstrate that data augmentations mitigate AR pretraining's data inefficiency and offer a promising solution to the data-constrained regime. All code and data are available at https://github.com/michaelchen-lab/data-augmentations-for-pretraining

AI.tldr: 本文提出数据增强作为正则化手段，解决语言模型预训练在数据受限、算力充足场景下多轮训练过拟合的问题，实验表明组合多种增强类别可有效降低验证损失。
AI.motivation: 随着AI实验室接近数据瓶颈（算力增速超过高质量文本生成速度），语言模型预训练转向数据受限、算力充足的新范式，标准自回归预训练在此设置下严重过拟合，需引入数据增强作为正则化手段以支持在同一数据上训练数百个epoch。
AI.method: 提出三类正交的数据增强方法：(1) 词级噪声（掩码、随机替换）；(2) 序列排列（从右到左预测、中间填充）；(3) 目标偏移预测（预测x_{t+i}, i>1）。通过系统性消融实验评估各方法及组合效果。
AI.result: (1) 各单独增强方法均能延迟过拟合并降低验证损失，其中随机标记替换取得最佳最小损失；(2) 组合不同类别增强可进一步降低最小验证损失；(3) 数据增强能够有效缓解自回归预训练的数据低效问题。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强为数据受限场景下的语言模型预训练提供了有前景的解决方案，能够有效缓解过拟合，支持数百个epoch的生产性训练。
AI.abstract_zh: 随着AI实验室接近数据天花板（计算能力超过高质量文本生成速率），语言模型预训练正转向一种数据受限、计算充足的新范式，这要求在固定语料库上进行高效的多轮训练。标准的自回归（AR）预训练在此设置下严重过拟合，其性能在达到最优后便持续恶化。我们研究将数据增强作为正则化手段来缓解这种过拟合，从而实现在同一数据上训练数百个epoch。我们提出了三类正交的自回归预训练增强方法：词级噪声（掩码、随机替换）、序列排列（从右到左预测、中间填充）以及目标偏移预测（预测x_{t+i}，其中i>1）。通过系统性消融实验，我们发现每种单独的增强方法都能延迟过拟合并相较于基线降低验证损失，其中随机标记替换在单独方法中取得了最佳的最小损失。组合不同类别的增强可以进一步降低最小验证损失。我们的实验表明，数据增强能够缓解自回归预训练的数据低效问题，并为数据受限场景提供了有前景的解决方案。所有代码和数据已开源至https://github.com/michaelchen-lab/data-augmentations-for-pretraining。

title: Ellipse Meets Bit-Planes: A Novel Approach to RNFL based Glaucoma Detection Using Advanced Image Processing and Deep Learning
summary: This work proposes an integrated pipeline for automatic glaucoma detection method from easily available colour fundas images based on an adaptive algorithm for ellipse-based polar transformation, to enhance the analysis of the Retinal Nerve Fiber Layer (RNFL) as the primary biomarker for observing glaucomatous changes, regardless of optic disc and macula position. Utilizing this transformation, we introduce two distinct frameworks tailored to different operational needs. The first framework, a deep learning-inspired feature fusion approach, achieves a 99.3% detection rate, ideal for settings where high precision is essential, despite higher computational demands. The second framework employs a novel image-processing algorithm based on bit-plane slicing, offering 92.31% accuracy and optimized for environments requiring rapid inference with minimal resource consumption. Both frameworks provide scalable and cost-effective solutions for early glaucoma detection. This study highlights the potential of RNFL-based diagnostic tools in addressing the global challenge of glaucoma, particularly in underserved regions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自适应椭圆极坐标变换的自动青光眼检测流水线，通过分析视网膜神经纤维层（RNFL）实现高精度检测，并设计了两种框架：深度学习的特征融合方法（99.3%检测率）和基于位平面切片的图像处理方法（92.31%准确率），适用于不同计算资源场景。
AI.motivation: 解决青光眼早期检测在全球范围内，尤其是医疗资源匮乏地区的挑战，利用易获取的彩色眼底图像，开发无需依赖视盘和黄斑位置的自动化检测方法。
AI.method: 提出基于自适应算法的椭圆极坐标变换，增强对RNFL的分析；基于此构建两种框架：1）深度学习特征融合方法；2）基于位平面切片的图像处理算法。
AI.result: 深度学习框架检测率达99.3%；位平面切片框架准确率为92.31%，且计算资源需求低、推理速度快。
AI.conclusion: 两种框架为早期青光眼检测提供了可扩展、低成本的解决方案，尤其在资源受限地区具有应用潜力，凸显了基于RNFL的诊断工具在应对全球青光眼挑战中的价值。
AI.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于自适应椭圆极坐标变换算法的自动青光眼检测集成流水线，该方法利用易于获取的彩色眼底图像，增强对视网膜神经纤维层（RNFL）的分析，将其作为观察青光眼改变的主要生物标志物，且无需依赖视盘和黄斑位置。利用该变换，我们引入了两种针对不同操作需求定制的框架。第一种框架采用深度学习启发的特征融合方法，实现了99.3%的检测率，适用于需要高精度的场景，尽管计算需求较高。第二种框架采用基于位平面切片的新型图像处理算法，准确率达92.31%，针对需要快速推理且资源消耗最小的环境进行了优化。两种框架为早期青光眼检测提供了可扩展且低成本的解决方案。本研究凸显了基于RNFL的诊断工具在应对全球青光眼挑战（尤其是医疗资源匮乏地区）中的潜力。

title: Variance Reduction for Non-Log-Concave Sampling with Applications to Inverse Problems
comment: Accepted to Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
summary: Sampling from high-dimensional, non-log-concave distributions with unnormalized densities is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, particularly when the exact gradient of the potential is unavailable and must be approximated via stochastic gradients that exhibit high variance under a fixed budget of gradient computations per iteration. Although variance reduction techniques such as SGD with momentum, STORM, and PAGE have demonstrated improved convergence properties in non-convex optimization, their implications for sampling from non-log-concave distributions remain largely unexplored. In this work, we develop the first unified analysis of these estimators for sampling from non-log-concave distributions. We establish improved non-asymptotic convergence rates in $\varepsilon$-relative Fisher information and, under a Poincaré inequality assumption, in squared total variation distance, and further prove weak convergence to the target distribution. We extend our analysis to solving inverse problems with score-based generative priors. We empirically validate our theory and demonstrate that, under a fixed gradient computations per iteration, variance-reduction techniques consistently improve sample quality in two standard imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对基于方差缩减技术（如SGD with momentum、STORM、PAGE）的高维非对数凹分布采样方法进行了统一分析，证明了在ε-相对Fisher信息、平方总变差距离下的改进非渐近收敛率，并扩展到基于分数的生成先验解决逆问题，实验验证了方差缩减能持续提升图像质量。
AI.motivation: 高维非对数凹分布的采样是机器学习中的基础难题，尤其当势函数精确梯度不可得、只能通过高方差随机梯度近似时。虽然方差缩减技术在非凸优化中已展现出优越性，但其对非对数凹分布采样的影响尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 对SGD with momentum、STORM、PAGE等方差缩减估计器在非对数凹分布采样中进行了统一分析，建立了ε-相对Fisher信息下的非渐近收敛率，并在Poincaré不等式假设下推导了平方总变差距离的收敛率，证明了弱收敛性，同时将分析扩展到基于分数的生成先验的逆问题求解。
AI.result: 建立了改进的非渐近收敛率（ε-相对Fisher信息和平方总变差距离），证明了弱收敛到目标分布，在两种标准成像应用中验证了固定梯度计算预算下方差缩减技术持续提升样本质量。
AI.conclusion: 方差缩减技术可以有效地应用于非对数凹分布采样，在理论和实验上都优于传统方法，并能推广到基于分数的生成先验的逆问题中。
AI.abstract_zh: 从具有未归一化密度的非对数凹高维分布中采样是机器学习中的一个基本挑战，特别是在势函数的精确梯度不可用、必须通过每次迭代固定梯度计算预算下呈现高方差的随机梯度来近似时。尽管诸如带动量的SGD、STORM和PAGE等方差缩减技术在非凸优化中已展现出改进的收敛性质，但它们对非对数凹分布采样的影响仍鲜有探索。在这项工作中，我们首次对这些估计器在非对数凹分布采样中进行了统一分析。我们在ε-相对Fisher信息下建立了改进的非渐近收敛率，并在Poincaré不等式假设下建立了平方总变差距离的收敛率，进一步证明了弱收敛到目标分布。我们将分析扩展到基于分数的生成先验求解逆问题。我们通过实验验证了理论，并证明在每次迭代固定梯度计算次数下，方差缩减技术能持续提升两种标准成像应用中的样本质量。

title: Faithful Action-unit Causal Reasoning for Counterfactually Faithful Emotion Explanations
summary: Multimodal models can name the action units (AUs) behind a facial emotion, but their AU->emotion rationales are typically plausible rather than faithful: nothing forces the AUs a model invokes to be the AUs that actually drive its prediction. We cast AU->emotion reasoning as a counterfactual-consistency problem between the rationale, the label, and a structural AU->emotion causal graph G, and propose FACR, which grounds the reasoner in an independently induced, polarity-aware G and trains a counterfactual-faithfulness objective: a do-intervention on an AU that G marks causal for a class must move the prediction, while one it marks irrelevant must leave it unchanged. Faithfulness is thereby both trainable and measurable through a matching interventional metric, which we evaluate against a known causal structure, the PSPI pain-AU composition, as no existing affective-reasoning benchmark allows. We are explicit that this metric tests fidelity to the supplied structure rather than its rediscovery: it asks whether the trained reasoner invokes the AUs the structure marks causal, on held-out subjects and a second dataset. Under subject-independent evaluation on UNBC-PAIN, the objective raises the agreement between the invoked AUs and the PSPI composition from a no-objective baseline of 0.08 to 0.57, at a small detection cost; an unfaithfulness control attributes the gain to the objective. On a cross-dataset emotion transfer, the objective likewise raises fidelity to G on a seven-class task (0.50 to 0.84). Finally, we attach a language verbalizer and extend the audit to the generated text: biasing each action unit's emission by its latent activation makes the rationale faithful by construction, so that ablating an AU removes it from the explanation, a property that transfers to a second language-model backbone, whereas a freely generated rationale is unfaithful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FACR框架，通过反事实一致性目标和结构因果图来训练多模态模型生成忠实于真实因果关系的AU→情绪推理，使模型调用的动作单元真正驱动其预测，而非仅表面合理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型在面部情绪识别中虽然能命名动作单元，但其AU→情绪的推理路径通常是表面上合理的而非真正忠实的：没有任何机制强制模型所调用的AU确实是驱动其预测的AU。
AI.method: 将AU→情绪推理建模为反事实一致性问题，引入结构因果图G，提出FACR框架：(1) 构建独立诱导的、具有极性感知的因果图G；(2) 训练反事实忠实性目标：对G标记为因果的AU执行do干预必须改变预测，对标记为无关的AU执行do干预则预测不变；(3) 通过匹配的干预指标衡量忠实性。
AI.result: 在UNBC-PAIN数据集上，主体独立评估下，目标函数将调用的AU与PSPI组合的一致性从0.08提升至0.57，检测成本微增；在跨数据集的七类情绪迁移任务上，对G的忠实性从0.50提升至0.84；将语言口头化器附加后，通过偏置每个AU的发射使其潜在激活，可使归因在构造上保持忠实。
AI.conclusion: FACR通过反事实一致性和结构因果图有效提升了AU→情绪推理的忠实性，可训练、可衡量，并能够迁移至语言模型解释生成中。
AI.abstract_zh: 多模态模型能够命名面部情绪背后的动作单元，但其从动作单元到情绪的推理解释通常只是表面上合理，而非真正忠实于模型的决策过程：没有任何机制强制模型所调用的动作单元确实是驱动其预测的动作单元。本文将从动作单元到情绪的推理建模为推理解释、标签与结构化AU→情绪因果图G之间的反事实一致性问题，并提出了FACR框架。该框架将推理器建立在独立诱导的、具有极性感知的因果图G上，并训练一个反事实忠实性目标：对G标记为某个类别因果因素的动作单元执行do干预，必须改变模型的预测；而对G标记为无关的动作单元执行do干预，则必须保持预测不变。由此，忠实性既可通过匹配的干预指标进行训练，也可进行衡量。由于现有情感推理基准无法支持此类评估，我们在已知因果结构——PSPI疼痛-AU组成——上对该指标进行评估。需要明确指出的是，该指标衡量的是对给定结构的忠实性，而非对其的重新发现：它检验的是训练后的推理器是否调用了结构标记为因果的动作单元，评估在留出主体及第二个数据集上进行。在UNBC-PAIN数据集上，采用主体独立评估时，该目标函数将调用的动作单元与PSPI组成的一致性从无目标基线的0.08提升至0.57，且仅牺牲少量检测性能；不忠实性控制实验证实该提升归因于目标函数本身。在跨数据集的情绪迁移任务中，该目标函数同样将在七类任务上对因果图G的忠实性从0.50提升至0.84。最后，我们附加了语言口头化器，将审计范围扩展至生成的文本：通过每个动作单元的潜在激活偏置其发射，使得归因在构造上保持忠实，从而消融某个动作单元会将其从解释中移除——这一属性可迁移至另一个语言模型骨干，而自由生成的归因则是不忠实的。

title: FlowMPC: Improving Flow Matching policies with World Models
summary: Flow Matching (FM) is a powerful approach for behavior cloning in multimodal action spaces [Jiang et al., 2025], but because it is not trained to directly maximize expected return, there is still room to improve how FM policies act at test time.
